programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood forstrong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching intoclassrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintainingbalance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Blue's Clues

programme.title: Ditzel Does Danmark

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: I første afsnit skal vi bl.a. se hvad den i dén grad selvstændige, Tonni Bonde - næsten helt gratis - har til salg ude på sin gård. Vi skal også møde den altid uheldige og plagede Karsten, som måske er gået hen og er blevet gravid

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Endnu et lækkert stykke af vores faste soap ’Drømme Om At Komme Væk - En By Ved Havet?’ Vi har også premiere på et grønt indslag, hvor naturvejleder Birthe Rigmor forklarer hvordan man redder æg. Djarvis har en allanhelvedes masse fede forretningsidéer.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Vi stifter bekendtskab med den meget mandige mand Micki Lynge, som lærer os at lave leverpostej. I 'Drømme Om At Komme Væk - En By Ved Havet', fantaserer de tre fyre om hvad de skal bruge a-l-l-e de penge til, som blev omtalt i det mystiske brev.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: I 'To Små Damer' er vi atter på besøg i pigeværelset, hvor der tales intimt om kroppe og hvad der sker med dem. Den voldsomt smukke og charmerende Fjeder, beretter om hvordan man håndterer en balkangangster fra et omrejsende tivoli.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Vi skal atter på besøg i den selvstændige sælger Tonni Bondes skur, for at finde ud af "hvad de unge vil ha'… Eller skal gi'". Den forpinte Karsten kommer endnu engang forbi med en ny frygtelig lidelse.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Djarvis, med de "allanhelvedes" masse fede forretningsidéer, har igen hittet på noget nyt. Karsten kommer forbi, da han tumler lidt med narkomani og den slags. Fjeder er også forbi for at fortælle en smule om da Per Syv og ham sammen oplevede Thylejren.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: TurboModul forsøger at bringe en undskyldning for de mange klager med kortfilmen 'Charter Med Charter På', som Lars har sat i søen. Og så viser Micki Lynge os, hvordan man laver den meget "udamede" ret sylte.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: I ottende og sidste afsnit beretter de unge kristne Coco og Jan om ikke-syndige film. Naturvejleder Birthe Rigmor giver 'do's and don'ts' (gør og ikk' gør), når man går på svampejagt i skoven.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Som en start finder vi bl.a. ud af, hvad der er så fedt ved København! Tonni Bonde har tilbud du ikke vil gå glip af og i den nye føljeton "Kærlighed til trods" ser vi livet som homoseksuelt provinspar, når den ene er bundet til en kørestol.

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: Rasmus får besøg af kærlighedsduoen Nina Ettrup og Eva Lund, der deler om deres kærlighedsliv på tv, fremtidsdrømme og udfordringer ved at date med hele Danmark som dommer. Spørgsmål fra skålen giver ærlige og saftige snakke i Skål For Sandheden.

programme.title: Modig
programme.desc: Jotam Confino gæster studiet og fortæller om sine oplevelser i Israel som journalist for nationale og internationale medier. Han deler også sin tilgang til kritik og vigtigheden af ærlighed i journalistik. En spændende og tankevækkende samtale.

programme.title: Hvad gjorde dig til
programme.desc: Tidligere frygtet bandemedlem, som engang forsøgte at skade en anden i en brutal konflikt. Efter fængsel har han vendt livet om, lever stabilt med familie og bruger sin historie til at hjælpe unge væk fra kriminalitet.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Din lille luder!”, sådan bliver der blandt andet sagt i en vild video, hvor vi får en skuespiller til at sige ting, som kunder rent faktisk har sagt i virkeligheden i en kundeservice i Bilka – en video, hvor vi virkelig var nervøse under optagelsen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang kommer det desværre virkelig til at handle om alle dem der IKKE hjælper. Vi kører i S-tog med en mand med sennep og ketchup i hele masken og vælter flere gange en helt tårn med toiletpapir ned i hoved på en ung pige OG ingen hjælper…

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi sminker Pelle 80 år gammel og lader den gamle mand tabe bukserne foran en masse måbende cafegæster. Samtidig overrasker en rimelig ordinær video med en kvinde, der skal ind i et tog med en barnevogn – den går nemlig viralt!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi forsætter med de voldsomme videoer, når vi sammen med DBU og Salling Group sætter fokus på de grimme tilråb forældre har, når deres små poder spiller bold. Hør blandt andet, hvorfor vi vælger at tage de værste tilråb først.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Selvom Karsten er blevet sigøjner vil han stadig helt vildt gerne lige aflevere "en dvd'er" tilbage til Lars som er på date. Det første kys kan være en svær størrelse at tale om, men i "Amazing Dan" er intet tabu for stort til at blive berørt.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Kunne et stykke højtbelagt afsnit seks friste? Ja? Så ta' for dig af retterne! Den kære Doktor Pyshue har fundet en underlig pibe i Rambos lastrum. Når doktoren at få et bap inden matrosen banker på?

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Endnu engang skal vi se og ikke mindst høre hvor skidt vor ven Karsten har det, når han besøger Lars midt i jobsamtale. Selv Fjeder skulle starte et sted, og det har han da tænkt sig fortælle om. Alt sammen og meget mere er i vente til den spændte seer!

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Sidste og verdens bedste afsnit for denne gang. Tonni Bonde synes fx at du bør købe en slæde. Helt seriøst. Hvis nu doktoren og Rambo leger 'doktor', hvem passer så skuden? Fjeder har været et smut forbi en S/M-klub. Har han faktisk taget munden for fuld?

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Det er første søndag i advent, og Ditzel er pissesur! Sidste år fik han nemlig alt for få julegaver, så i år vil han have fat i ham den røde prop, som står for uddelingen af alle gaverne.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ditzel er rejst helt hen til det lokale indkøbscenter, for der plejer Julemanden jo altid at hænge ud med en masse unger på skødet. Det er et oplagt sted at starte!

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: I “Skål For Sandheden” besøger Mette Søndergaard Nielsen og Elisa Lykke Rasmus Lindbjerg til en sladderaften. De snakker Reddit, sex-skandaler og vild kærlighedsflugt. Intet pakkes ind – bare ærlig underholdning!

programme.title: Her er dit madliv
programme.desc: Eva deler historier fra sin tid som statist i italiensk film, sin kærlighed til det italienske køkken (og et par mænd) – og genopfrisker de pastaregler, som vi danskere ofte glemmer!

programme.title: Hvad gjorde dig til
programme.desc: Lars har besøg af Ulrich Larsen, aka Muldvarpen. Hvordan fandt han mod til at rejse undercover til Nordkorea? Hvad lå bag beslutningen, og hvordan har det påvirket hans liv? En spændende samtale om mod og oplevelser.

programme.title: Hvad gjorde dig til
programme.desc: Camilla Ottesen deler åbent om sit liv og rejse i studiet. Kan man starte en TV-karriere ved at klippe sig skaldet? Camilla kunne! Hør det spændende interview med Lars Rasmussen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Normalt hylder vi folk, der reagerer på vores små set ups rundt omkring, men her hylder vi folk, der til dagligt gør gode gerninger – og vi tager hyldesterne til nye højder, så vildt at en af dem kalder det ”SVINERI”!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Den Gode Gerning” er skudt i gang, og som noget nyt hylder Pelle og René folk, der til dagligt gør en forskel for andre. Det bliver virkelig rørende, da de hjælper brystkræftramte Malene med at sige tak til hendes hjælpsomme veninde Michelle.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi ved godt, at det er tarveligt at bruge små søde børn, der har brug for hjælp. Det er nemlig et billigt trick, MEN det virker. Og en ting er, at set up’et er sødt, men ham der hjælpers reaktion er virkelig også skøn – det er jul, når det er bedst!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Det tog Malte Ebert cirka 2 sekunder at overveje, om han ville være med i en video, hvor vi hylder skønne, hjælpsomme Cecilie, der elsker Malte. Kom bag om videoen, hvor vi sammen med Malte og 100 andre tager fusen på Cecilie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Der går nærmest hjælpemiddelcentral i den i de videoer, der med i dag – to ældre mennesker med rollatorer og Pelle i en rullestol. Det er med andre ord scenarier med folk, der virkelig har brug for hjælp og dermed ekstra rørende, når folk springer til.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En ellers lidt ordinær video EKSPLODEREDE på Tik Tok, da en mand der hjalp sagde nej til Pelles blomster med ordene ”Nej tak, jeg er til kvinder – helst!”. Vi taler om, hvad der har overrasket os i forhold til hvilke videoer der når langt ud.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Pelle og René sætter ord på tilblivelsen af ”Den Gode Gerning”. Hør hvordan René nærmest ved et tilfælde bliver revet med i foretagendet, og så står de med en vild opdagelse efter, de har optaget de første videoer – det er kun de ”gamle” der hjælper!!

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Lars har fået ondt af Jacob. Han husker selv hvor svært den slags med tøser kunne være, og kan være. Derfor har Lars (måske mod betaling) fået fat i en “tøs”, der trods den ret voldsomme aldersforskel, er interesseret i en date med Jacob.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Dagen er kommet, hvor Jacob Ditzel skal kongdiameres - hvis altså verdens ringeste præst har tænkt sig at give ham lov.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv
programme.desc: Efter noget klamt kød skyller Ditzel smagen væk med lokalt vand - men så begynder hans mave at opføre sig underligt.

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv
programme.desc: Lars forsøger at slå to fluer med et smæk og inviterer Ditzel med op at flyve luftballon.

programme.title: De Entreprenante

programme.title: Naturligheder

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En af de bedste gerninger, man kan gøre, er at sige noget pænt til en fremmed. Det er vi ikke så gode til her i landet, derfor lader vi selvfølgelig en mand gøre det. Det er SÅ fedt, dejligt og tankevækkende at se folks reaktioner på de søde ord.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang fortæller vi blandt andet om den nok mest populære video, vi har lavet – en video med Lukas Graham, der overrasker en hjælpsom fan, 10-årige Felix. Felix er SÅ sødt og hans reaktion trækker tårer hos alle der ser videoen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi kommer omkring nogle klassiske videoer, og så prøver vi noget nyt. Vi får en bager til at give en gratis brunsviger til dem, der vælger at sætte musik på og danse i butikken – det er det sjoveste vi har lavet!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Din lille luder!”, sådan bliver der blandt andet sagt i en vild video, hvor vi får en skuespiller til at sige ting, som kunder rent faktisk har sagt i virkeligheden i en kundeservice i Bilka – en video, hvor vi virkelig var nervøse under optagelsen.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Gravity
programme.desc: Stranded on a desolate planet with a beautiful female, Tuvok struggles to ignore the emotions his Vulcan master taught him to suppress.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Invisible Intruder
programme.desc: In 1996, police received a call from Darlie Routier telling them of her two sons' murders. The police found the killer by analyzing blood spatter, doing behavioral profiling and analyzing Darlie's 911 call.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong

programme.desc: Djarvis, med de "allanhelvedes" masse fede forretningsidéer, har igen hittet på noget nyt. Karsten kommer forbi, da han tumler lidt med narkomani og den slags. Fjeder er også forbi for at fortælle en smule om da Per Syv og ham sammen oplevede Thylejren.

programme.desc: TurboModul forsøger at bringe en undskyldning for de mange klager med kortfilmen 'Charter Med Charter På', som Lars har sat i søen. Og så viser Micki Lynge os, hvordan man laver den meget "udamede" ret sylte.

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: Rasmus Lindbjerg får besøg af Sarah Grünewald og Jakob Fauerby, der snakker om TV2-programmet Spillet, deres seneste projekter og udfordringer. De leger “Hvornår har du sidst…” og svarer på skålens spørgsmål i en ærlig og underholdende episode.

programme.title: 2 Ristede
programme.desc: To garvede fodboldspillere, Allan O og Dennis Cagara, fortæller om fodboldens bagside – anekdoter, sejre, skuffelser og rå sandheder, både på og uden for banen. Helt uden filter.

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm
programme.desc: I afsnit 14 gæster Allan O og Dennis Cagara, tidligere professionelle fodboldspillere, studiet. Kendt for practical jokes, griner vi af historier om pis, lort, nøgenhed, kys og badekar mellem mænd, fascination af mænds vedhæng og meget mere.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang kommer det desværre virkelig til at handle om alle dem der IKKE hjælper. Vi kører i S-tog med en mand med sennep og ketchup i hele masken og vælter flere gange en helt tårn med toiletpapir ned i hoved på en ung pige OG ingen hjælper…

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi sminker Pelle 80 år gammel og lader den gamle mand tabe bukserne foran en masse måbende cafegæster. Samtidig overrasker en rimelig ordinær video med en kvinde, der skal ind i et tog med en barnevogn – den går nemlig viralt!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi forsætter med de voldsomme videoer, når vi sammen med DBU og Salling Group sætter fokus på de grimme tilråb forældre har, når deres små poder spiller bold. Hør blandt andet, hvorfor vi vælger at tage de værste tilråb først.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Normalt hylder vi folk, der reagerer på vores små set ups rundt omkring, men her hylder vi folk, der til dagligt gør gode gerninger – og vi tager hyldesterne til nye højder, så vildt at en af dem kalder det ”SVINERI”!

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.desc: Ytterst på et svaberg ved Tjomsland i Larvik kommune ligger en hytte du knapt kan se. Her gjenbrukes mer enn vanlig, men hytta er likevel ikke til å kjenne igjen når uka er omme.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 904

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2503

programme.title: Dom kallar meg Trinity - Djävulens högra hand
programme.desc: Han har en käft lika väloljad som hans revolver. Han säger att han är en fredens man - men vem vågar tro honom? Hans namn är Trinity - Djävulens högra hand.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Inget är som ett pyjamasparty

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Små Vita Körer
programme.desc: När en elak tjej vid namn Veronica saboterar för Phoebe i kören och utnyttjar Max genom att få honom att göra hennes läxor, samarbetar tvillingarna för att ta hämnd på henne.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kalla Doktorerna Thunderman
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe passar Billy och får ta honom till sjukhus när han skadar tummen. Efter att Max sett en nål och svimmat, måste de allihop se till att doktorerna inte ser röntgenbilderna av hans hjärna, för då kan hans superkrafter avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kemi är Magi

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fyra Superhjältar och en Bebis
programme.desc: Phoebe släpar med Billy och Nora till parken för att träffa killen hon är kär i och hans lilla lillebror, men när Max kommer för att hämta sina syskon tar han av misstag den riktiga bebisen i stället för Noras docka.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Det är dags för auktion där bland annat en immunitet kan klubbas hem – men hur mycket är gästerna egentligen beredda på att satsa?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Auktionens immunitet och par-blockering förändrar förutsättningarna för kvällens parceremoni. En av våra backpackers kommer att få ta sin väska och checka ut från hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Det är Gladiatorvecka på Paradise Hotel och en kejsare checkar in. Vem kommer han att välja som sin kejsarinna och vem av de andra killarna hamnar på Solo?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: En bekant gladiator är tillbaka för hämnd. Gamla sår ska rivas upp, svek ska betalas tillbaka – och mitt i allt kan ett triangeldrama vara på väg att explodera.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2614

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2615
programme.desc: Markus och Veronica har bara varit tillsammans i två år men har redan hunnit gifta sig och skaffa barn. Veronica fick en chock i december förra året när hon fick reda på att Markus har stora skulder.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2616

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2701
programme.desc: Lisa från Tvååker lever på ytan ett härligt familjeliv med två barn, hus och sambo. Men under ytan döljer sig enorma skulder och ett spelmissbruk som hon hållit hemligt för sin sambo.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 430

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 501

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 502

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 504

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: A couple discover a strange room in their new house that grants material wishes, but all they want is a child.

programme.title: Satan's Slaves
programme.desc: After dying from a strange illness that she suffered for three years, a mother returned home to pick up her children.

programme.title: Satan's Slaves: Communion
programme.desc: Several years after a terrible incident cost their mother and youngest sibling their lives, Rini and her siblings Toni and Bondi live with their father in flats. They believe living in flats with many people is safe, but they soon realize this might be dangerous if they don't know their neighbors. On a night full of terror, Rini and her family must save themselves.

programme.title: Son
programme.desc: When a young boy falls ill to a mysterious illness, his mother must decide how far she will go to protect him from terrifying forces in her past.

programme.title: Speak No Evil
programme.desc: On a vacation in Toscana, a Danish family instantly becomes friends with a Dutch family. Months later, the Danish couple receives an unexpected invitation. It doesn't take long before the joy of reunion is replaced with misunderstandings.

programme.title: The Wind
programme.desc: Lizzy is a tough, resourceful frontierswoman settling a remote stretch of land on the 19th-century American frontier. Isolated from civilization in a desolate wilderness where the wind never stops howling, she begins to sense a sinister presence that seems to be borne of the land itself, an overwhelming dread that her husband dismisses as superstition. When a newlywed couple arrive at a nearby homestead, their presence amplifies Lizzy's fears, setting into motion a shocking chain of events.

programme.title: The Dark and the Wicked
programme.desc: Plagued by waking nightmares, two siblings suspect that something evil is taking over their family at an isolated farmhouse.

programme.title: Color Out of Space
programme.desc: After a meteorite lands in the front yard of their farm, Nathan Gardner and his family find themselves battling a mutant extraterrestrial organism that infects their minds and bodies, transforming their quiet rural life into a technicolor nightmare.

programme.title: The Clovehitch Killer
programme.desc: After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.

programme.title: Hunter Hunter
programme.desc: A fur trapper leaves his wife and daughter behind to kill a rogue wolf in the remote wilderness. But they soon become increasingly worried when a severely injured man shows up to disrupt their peaceful existence.

programme.title: Consecration
programme.desc: After the suspicious death of her brother, a priest, Grace travels to the Mount Saviour Convent in Scotland to find out what really happened. Once there, she uncovers murder, sacrilege and a disturbing truth about her own past.

programme.title: Blood Quantum
programme.desc: The dead are coming back to life and almost all of Earth's population is decimated due to a zombie virus, except for the isolated Mi'kmaq reserve of Red Crow, whose indigenous inhabitants are strangely immune to the zombie plague.

programme.title: Virus-32
programme.desc: A virus spreads throughout the city, causing the infected to become vicious hunters. Iris and her daughter become caught in the massacre, discovering 32-second periods of calm before each attack.

programme.title: Almost Human
programme.desc: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

programme.title: The Sadness
programme.desc: As Taiwan succumbs to a viral pandemic that transforms peaceful citizens into sadistic, bloodthirsty maniacs, a young couple must battle to be reunited before they too become infected.

programme.title: Devil's Pass
programme.desc: To determine what happened to some Russian hikers, five U.S. college students go back to where the hikers were found dead. The students don't return from the expedition, either, and the recovered footage is deemed too disturbing for public viewing.

programme.title: Contracted
programme.desc: A young woman (Najarra Townsend) begins bleeding, shedding maggots and hallucinating after a stranger date rapes her at a party.

programme.title: Allegoria
programme.desc: A timid actress, a tortured painter, a pretentious writer, a psychotic sculptor and a rock band all become entangled when their insecurities manifest themselves into monsters and ghouls.

programme.title: Blood Flower
programme.desc: A young apprentice healer tries to suppress his supernatural abilities so he can fit in with the other kids, but when a malicious spirit breaks out in his apartment he decides to use his abilities while dark family secrets are revealed.

programme.title: Revealer
programme.desc: A stripper and a religious protester are trapped together in a peep show booth and must come together to survive the apocalypse.

programme.title: Scare Package
programme.desc: Seven filmmakers present seven terrifying and comedic tales of horror.

programme.title: PG: Psycho Goreman
programme.desc: Intergalactic assassins converge on a small town after two siblings unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord.

programme.title: All the Creatures Were Stirring
programme.desc: The joyful spirit of Christmas takes one dark turn after another -- from sadistic office parties and last-minute shopping nightmares to vengeful stalkers and immortal demons.

programme.title: Glorious
programme.desc: A heartbroken man finds himself trapped in a bathroom with a strange voice who says he may be the only hope in stopping a terrible event.

programme.title: Skull: The Mask
programme.desc: A supernatural serial killer based on pre-Colombian mythology hunts for revenge in the metropolis of São Paulo.

programme.title: MadS
programme.desc: Eighteen-year-old Romain has just graduated and makes a stop at his dealer's place to try a new pill. As he heads off to a party, he sees an injured woman on the side of the road and decides to help her, but when she gets in his car, she suddenly smashes her own head against the dashboard, bleeding out until she dies.

programme.title: Blood Glacier
programme.desc: Scientists discover that a red liquid leaking from a nearby glacier contains organisms that turn living hosts into deadly mutants.

programme.title: Sisters of Mercy
programme.desc: A rehabilitation center staffed by Catholic nuns faces closure after an investigation into allegations of sexual molestation leads to rape charges.

programme.title: Surrender Dorothy
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green first suspect gang members when a woman is found stuffed inside a car trunk, until they find out that she was married and having an affair.

programme.title: Untitled
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green learn that a murdered woman was not only a patron of the arts, but that an artist she supported created a painting similar to the crime scene.

programme.title: Narcosis
programme.desc: The detectives' investigation into the strangulation of an Asian-American stripper leads them to corrupt officers.

programme.title: High & Low
programme.desc: The detectives struggle to determine the motive of a club owner who hired two men to kill a stripper.

programme.title: Stiff
programme.desc: The detectives suspect a comatose woman's husband tried either to commit a mercy killing or to kill her for her money.

programme.title: Vaya con Dios
programme.desc: McCoy seeks to prosecute a high-level foreign dignitary for the torture and murder of a New York student 27 years earlier.

programme.title: Sweeps
programme.desc: After a child molester is killed by a victim's father on the set of a talk show, Stone investigates the host to prove he masterminded the meeting for ratings.

programme.title: Volunteers
programme.desc: Two tenants of an apartment building decide to cancel a homeless man's lease on life after his screaming frustrates the neighborhood.

programme.title: Discord
programme.desc: A heavy-metal rock star known for videos that are degrading to women is investigated for raping a college student.

programme.title: Profile
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan search for a serial killer after an African-American woman's murder matches a pattern of recent racial attacks.

programme.title: Black Tie
programme.desc: Logan and Briscoe investigate the children and widow of a tycoon after evidence is uncovered that he may have been murdered.

programme.title: Pride and Joy
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan investigate when a man is killed after being emotionally and physically abused for years by his gifted son.

programme.title: Apocrypha
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan bring a religious cult's leader to court after a woman is killed while planting a car bomb.

programme.title: American Dream
programme.desc: Stone and Kincaid (Michael Moriarty, Jill Hennessy) investigate further when a businessman (guest star Zeljko Ivanek) is acquitted of murder.

programme.title: Born Bad
programme.desc: Defense attorneys for a foster child who killed argue that he was genetically predisposed to violence.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happiness
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan's (Jerry Orbach, Chris Noth) investigation into a man's death leads them to a Russian mail-order bride (guest star Natalya Negoda). With Michael Moriarty.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: An emaciated elderly woman is found dead of an apparent heart attack; her granddaughter is charged with neglect and grave indifference to human life.

programme.title: Snatched
programme.desc: Kidnappers abduct the son of Schiff's friend and entomb him in the basement of an abandoned building.

programme.title: Breeder
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan help a young mother who claims her newborn baby was stolen from her after she gave birth in a taxi on the way to the hospital.

programme.title: Censure
programme.desc: Stone faces a tough court battle when a judge is placed on trial and claims the case against him is the vendetta of a former lover.

programme.title: Kids
programme.desc: Briscoe finds it difficult to arrest the son of his former partner when the teen is charged with the murder of a boy in a drive-by shooting.

programme.title: Big Bang
programme.desc: A physicist is linked to a package delivered through the mail that exploded and killed a rival's wife.

programme.title: Mayhem
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan (Jerry Orbach, Chris Noth) investigate five homicides in one chaotic day at the 27th Precinct. Guest stars: Alice Drummond, Victor Colicchio.

programme.title: Cradle to Grave
programme.desc: Stone brings charges against an apartment building's landlord and superintendent after a baby freezes to death.

programme.title: The Fertile Fields
programme.desc: The murder of a Jewish diamond merchant apparently because of bias turns out to be a cover-up of embezzlement.

programme.title: Intolerance
programme.desc: As the detectives search for a racial motive in the slaying of a Chinese honor student, they receive a tip leading them to the boy's scholastic rival.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: Following the murder of a councilman, Cerreta and Logan investigate a blackmail ring; Stone prosecutes a fellow lawyer.

programme.title: Wager
programme.desc: The detectives investigate the death of a famous baseball player's father, who gambled his son's earnings on sporting events.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Racial tensions explode into violence after a middle-aged Jewish man leaves the scene of an accident involving a 12-year-old African-American boy.

programme.title: Nurture
programme.desc: A 10-year-old disappears after being taken from her alcoholic mother and placed with an abusive couple.

programme.title: Doubles
programme.desc: An investigation reveals a strange plot when a professional tennis player's wrist is broken after she finishes a practice session with a former rival.

programme.title: Old Friends
programme.desc: Stone contemplates resigning when the mob retaliates against his prosecution of a member of a notorious crime family.

programme.title: Second Opinion
programme.desc: A doctor is charged with murder for prescribing a treatment that caused toxic fumes to emit from a breast-cancer patient's body.

programme.title: Coma
programme.desc: Kincaid and McCoy have to decide whether to risk killing a comatose woman to recover the bullet they need as evidence.

programme.title: Blue Bamboo
programme.desc: A young actress claiming to have been the victim of a white slavery ring becomes the prime suspect when a wealthy Japanese businessman is murdered.

programme.title: Family Values
programme.desc: After the body of a wealthy woman is found in the East River, her daughter and her husband become murder suspects.

programme.title: White Rabbit
programme.desc: A safe-deposit-box company eventually exposes a political activist who went underground 20 years earlier to avoid a murder charge.

programme.title: Competence
programme.desc: Briscoe, Logan, McCoy and Kincaid try to clear Van Buren's name after she shoots a pair of young men who accost her at an automated teller machine.

programme.title: Precious
programme.desc: A girl found dead in a cooler may have been the victim of parents suffering from an unusual psychological illness.

programme.title: Virtue
programme.desc: McCoy and Kincaid find themselves in a unique situation when a high-powered city attorney accuses a city councilman of sexual harassment.

programme.title: Scoundrels
programme.desc: A corporate raider is linked to the murder of a sleazy lawyer who planned a class action suit against him.

programme.title: House Counsel

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Vegetarian

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Seared Steak
programme.desc: Today Lidia shows how to perfectly prepare delicious seared steak with rosemary sauce, shallots and mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Focaccia
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even for stuffing. Lidia begins by making a classic rosemary and lemon focaccia; she then moves on to a filled focaccia with smoky speck and fontina cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a salad of shrimp, fava, and cranberry beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Gnocchi
programme.desc: If there were another name for Lidia's family, it would be the gnocchi family. Lidia starts with a butternut squash gnocchi that is as soft as a feather and served with a velvety sage and butter sauce. Next, she prepares a marinated bread of chicken seared with shiitake mushrooms, rosemary, and sage. Her sauteed earthy Brussels sprouts are made with pepperoncino, garlic, and walnuts.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Time for Brunch
programme.desc: Brunch Italian Style! Learn to make savory rustic Oatmeal Biscuits. Then have a whole meal inside a plump Gluttonous Tomato - it's an easy dish of tomatoes stuffed with bread, herbs cheese and eggs. On the side, a versatile String Bean salad of with Capers and Basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Under the Sea
programme.desc: Lidia creates Clam Bruschetta with bread, pairs mushrooms with Scallops and Scallions, and makes a tuna salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: Lidia's reinventing Italian classics. Learn to make Lidia's fresh Mozzarella salad not with tomatoes but Celery and walnuts instead. She puts a spin on the classic Pappa al Pomodoro from Maremma by adding clams! Plus, a crowd-pleasing Zucchini Parmigiana, a delicious variation of on tried and true eggplant version.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Baked Pasta
programme.desc: Everyone loves baked pasta, and in this episode, Lidia prepares a baked penne dish with a comforting pork ragu and zucchini topped with a golden crust of cheese. She also makes an elegant salad of asparagus, scallions, and boiled egg and finishes the meal with a delicious and moist chocolate zucchini cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Antipasti
programme.desc: Lidia shares several dishes that will work for any party, including a selection of cheese, cured meat, and Giardiniera-style vegetables; an easy and quick sweet & sour zucchini dish and lastly stuffed mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers, and fresh parsley. Lastly, there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels, and calamari.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Beef
programme.desc: "There's nothing as good as a good piece of meat", and as Julia is quick to point out, there is less and less really good (well marbled and aged) beef to be found. Hangar Steak, Skirt Strip, Flank and Ribeye.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Desserts
programme.desc: Jacques and Julia create some very special desserts in this colorful episode. Poires Belle Helene - poached pear perched atop pound cake drizzled with chocolate sauce; sweet creamy rich and delicious Strawberries Sabayon; and Crepes Suzette, classically flambéed and served with orange butter and powdered sugar, as well as a Hungarian inspired torta of layered crepes baked with raspberry jam.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Salads
programme.desc: Jacques dressed in a toga? For the Julia's Caesar Salad, of course! This show has a salad for everyone, from a simple mixed green salad with a garlic vinaigrette, to classic Caesar and Nicoise (with fresh seared tuna) Salads. How about some Potato Salad? Well, Julia and Jacques prepare two: an American style potato salad with home made mayonnaise, and its tart French cousin.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Sandwiches
programme.desc: As a child, one of Julia's favorite sandwiches was an ice cream sandwich. Jacques was a stick of chocolate between two pieces of bread. Today, Julia's favorite is the Croque Monsieur, or pressed and baked ham & cheese. Of course, Jacques provides a variation he calls a Croque Madam. A close second they can both agree on is the New England lobster roll, served on a toasted hot dog bun.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Vegetables
programme.desc: Julia and Jacques prepare artichokes-several ways-including artichoke hearts stuffed with spinach and mushroom Duxelle. Julia demonstrates her secret to ever-green cooked string beans and butter bruised peas. Jacques counters with his aromatic Tomato Provencal.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Pork
programme.desc: A classic of the American table--pork chops and applesauce, is the starting point for three J&J improvisations: aromatic grilled, stuffed pork chops with rosemary, served with a tomato, red onion and avocado salad; loin of pork with sautéed red cabbage and apples, and Pork Tenderloin Medallions with port wine and macerated prunes on a bed of orzo.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Comfort Food
programme.desc: Poached chicken, chicken pot pie and rustic apple tart dessert. Julia and Jacques show how simple it is to poach a chicken with vegetables, mushrooms and a little white wine, and then take that poaching liquid and use it with the leftover poached chicken for a flaky crusted chicken pot pie. The same simple pastry Julia makes for the pot pie is perfect base for a rustic apple and dried fruit tart.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Fire Kings
programme.desc: Pati visits Weber's back patio for cabrito and short ribs. Chef Villareal puts a twist on traditional dishes.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
programme.desc: Pati explores Nuevo León: the land of cabrito and carne asada. Here, chefs challenge the state's culinary stereotypes, transforming traditional flavors into exciting new experiences.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The World Cup of Tacos
programme.desc: Pati explores Nuevo León: the land of cabrito and carne asada. Here, chefs challenge the state's culinary stereotypes, transforming traditional flavors into exciting new experiences.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Maestros Del Pan
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati learns his secret to making the perfect campechana.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Piloncillo
programme.desc: Pati explores Nuevo León: the land of cabrito and carne asada. Here, chefs challenge the state's culinary stereotypes, transforming traditional flavors into exciting new experiences.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Day With Hugo
programme.desc: Pati explores Nuevo León: the land of cabrito and carne asada; where chefs challenge culinary stereotypes.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Extreme Smoke
programme.desc: In this "surf and turf" show, a marine biologist brings ocean-fresh sea urchins for Steven to grill. Local spiny lobster is split and roasted in the shell directly on the embers. Meanwhile, Alaskan king crab gets grilled and served with garlicky absinthe butter. Representing turf are bone-in veal chops blasted with rosemary smoke and beef plate ribs, spit-roasted on a wood-burning rotisserie.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Project Smoke Road Trip
programme.desc: Steven takes a field trip to the famed Hitching Post II in Buellton, California, where owner Frank Ostini demonstrates the ultimate Santa Maria barbecue. Back on the set, Santa Barbara fisherwoman Stephanie Munz shares her secret for grilled whelks (sea snails). The celebration continues as we meet some of the production crew and go behind the scenes of Project Smoke.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Global Tailgate
programme.desc: Victory will be yours! Start the party with chicken legs smoke-roasted over maple wood, then glazed with a fiery fusion of maple syrup and sriracha. A quartet of grilled and smoked beans appears in a colorful side dish. Next up, a trio of internationally-inspired burgers: inside-out American-style burgers; Greek-style spiced lamb burgers; and kaffir lime-scented Thai veal burgers.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Mexican Smoke
programme.desc: Its bright but complex flavors and affinity for smoke and fire have fueled the obsession with Mexican food and drink north of the border. Tomatoes, onions, and chiles are roasted in the coals to make an unforgettable salsa. Quesadillas conceal a perfectly cooked egg. Then, a Grilled Nopalitos Corn Salad and chipotle-marinated pork tenderloin. To finish, pineapple slices flambéed with mezcal.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - South American Smoke
programme.desc: This show highlights the conviviality of a South American cookout. The secrets to recreate the pollo served in Peruvian enclaves will be revealed in this episode. Little known in the U.S. is choripan, a kind of Andean hot dog. Finally, Brazilian churrasco is made of spit-roast picanha (top sirloin cap), chicken thighs, kielbasa, peppers, and onions-all served with a Brazilian country-style salsa.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - BBQ's Trinity
programme.desc: This show celebrates the holy BBQ trinity of barbecue: pork ribs, brisket, and pulled pork. America's favorite ribs-baby backs-are glazed with an unexpected ingredient. Beef brisket and baked beans star in crispy grilled tostadas. An amazing BBQ Titans' brisket with espresso in the barbecue sauce. Finally, pulled pork marinated in an umami-rich Korean chili paste called gochujang.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Perfect Hog
programme.desc: This show goes whole hog! Up first, pastrami bacon made by brine-curing pork belly, rubbing it with a pastrami rub, and finally slow-smoking it over hardwood. Then an apple cider-based brine and rum-spiked finishing glaze pork chops. Next, "pork and beans" like you've never seen them. Finally, rings of sweet onions are doused with hot sauce, spiraled with bacon, and crisped over the fire.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Pac-Rim Smoke
programme.desc: Pan-Asian pit masters (and mistresses) developed a grill culture that celebrates the "fifth taste," umami. Striped bass is stuffed and grilled before it's doused with hot sesame oil. Thai Beef Salad is a mosaic of color and textures. Corn comes basted with sesame soy butter and finished with fire-toasted coconut. Last up, pounded chicken thighs get basted with Beijing Barbecue Sauce.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What it was like to visit a Medieval Tavern
programme.desc: Max explores medieval English taverns, inns, and alehouses, each serving different roles and social classes. Taverns sold wine, inns provided lodging, and alehouses were private homes selling ale. The episode covers wine quality control, bread and ale laws, and their reputations for gambling and excess. He recreates bokenade, a beef pottage with saffron, cloves, and verjuice.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Food was Served at Wild West Saloons?
programme.desc: Max explores the Old West saloon as a social hub for food and drink. He covers its evolving design, popular beverages like whiskey, beer, champagne, and cocktails, gambling games such as poker, and the famous "free lunch" tradition. The episode highlights regional foods, oysters' popularity, and recreates an 1886 pork and beans recipe from *Cooking for Profit*.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Cooking on the American Home Front During WWII
programme.desc: Max explores WWII home front rationing in the U.S., from 1942 sugar limits to the red and blue point system for meat, dairy, and canned goods. He covers price controls, Victory Gardens, labor shortages, internment camps, and black-market "meatleggers." He also recreates Betty Crocker's "emergency steak," a budget-friendly mix of ground beef, cereal, and milk.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Dining First Class on the RMS Titanic
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's luxurious first class, from modest suites to lavish parlor suites with private promenades. He covers dining in the saloon and Ritz, daily meals, amenities like the gym and Turkish bath, and the 10+ course final dinner. Using survivor accounts, he recreates the famous peaches in Chartreuse jelly dessert from April 14, 1912.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - First Class Breakfast on the RMS Titanic
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's first class breakfast from April 11, 1912, featuring over a dozen dishes by Escoffier. He recreates baked apples, smoked salmon coronets, shirred eggs, and buckwheat cakes with blackcurrant conserve. The episode highlights dining venues, passenger pets, and the tragic story of honeymooners Victor and Maria Josefa Peñasco.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Pioneers ate on the Oregon Trail
programme.desc: Max explores the 4-6 month, 2,200-mile Oregon Trail journey (1846-1869), covering provisions like flour, bacon, and hardtack, cooking over buffalo chips, and staple meals like Johnny cakes. He discusses hunting, trading with Native Americans, celebrations, and hardships, including spoiled food, salt-rising bread, pies, and pioneers leaving possessions at Fort Laramie.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Recreating the Last Meal of Ötzi the Iceman
programme.desc: Max recreates Ötzi the Iceman's last meal (c. 3,359-3,105BC), discovered in 1991. He covers Ötzi's clothing, tools, health (tattoos, heart disease, parasites), and likely murder by arrow. Using stomach contents-smoked ibex, charred red deer, and einkorn pancake with fiddle ferns-Max cooks over an open fire to mimic Neolithic methods.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Airline Food During the Golden Age of Air Travel
programme.desc: Max traces airline food from 1919's first commercial meal to aviation's Golden Age (1950s-70s). He covers flight kitchens, cold-to-hot meal evolution, themed flights, flight attendant hiring, the 1958 Great Sandwich War, and 1978 deregulation. Max recreates a 1954 United Airlines meal of pot roast, vegetables, Delmonico potatoes, and marshmallow-apple salad.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Medieval Irish Food: Peasant to King
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland's rigid food hierarchy-peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat-and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal's gluttony.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Eating like a Lighthouse Keeper from the 1800's
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job-cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer's 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Got Lemons, Make Gnocchi
programme.desc: Mary Ann teaches her Scuola Culinaria student, Karen the traditional Italian culinary secrets of creating soft-as-a-cloud, pillowy gnocchi every time. When they're as perfect as these Amalfi-style gnocchi, all that's needed is a buttery, heavy cream sauce of asparagus tips and lemon zest to make you close your eyes, take one taste and swear you're in Amalfi.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Gaetano's Easy Chicken Casserole
programme.desc: In a matter of minutes, Mary Ann combines sliced chicken breasts with onions, garlic, and turmeric and into the oven it goes to create her husband's recipe Guy's Chicken with Olives and Turmeric. Then she makes another favorite, Meatballs Milan Style. Stuffed with filled with mortadella, beef, and ham and fried to a crunchy crisp, you'll want seconds, thirds, fourths!

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Make Pizza with a Friend
programme.desc: Mary Ann and eager Scuola Culinaria student John roll up their sleeves and dive into the essential steps need to create an all-time favorite of favorites, Pizza Margherita. Step by step, sauce by sauce, cheese by cheese learn how to take your pizza all the way from yeast to "Yay!" And they're not done yet, not until they make Fried Dough with Cinnamon and Sugar from yeast to "Yum!"

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Pesto Pairings
programme.desc: Mary Ann teams up with Executive Chef David Crinieri to wow her cooking students by exploring the world of perfect pestos. Chef David leads off with a delicate Watercress Pesto tossed with Fresh Spinach Linguine and topped with an Artichoke Crudo. Mary Ann's up next with her signature Broccolini and Artichoke Pesto tossed with Fusilli. Want perfect pesto every time? Try either one-or both!

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Wild
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Bovina Farm and Fermentory Story
programme.desc: Georgia visits the Catskills in New York, where a couple has created a stunning homestead and serves their community through weekly dinners that now attract people from afar. She heads out into the woods, into the root cellar, and into the kitchen with Jake and Elizabeth as they create a beautiful meal for dinner guests. The couple shares how they created this space and offer inspiring ideas for living and entertaining.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tinos: Ancient Marble, Timeless Flavors
programme.desc: Diane visits a famous local marble sculptor en route to visit an old friend and great cook, where she learns the secrets of pinched sweet cheese cakes, ancient sesame-honey confections and more. Back in her own kitchen, she creates a luscious Tinos-style artichoke bread pudding and red mullet in caper sauce, both Tinos traditional specialties.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Food Secrets Of Mykonos
programme.desc: On Mykonos, Diane discovers the quiet life and food of its local farmers, in contrast to the reputation as a dazzling party island. She tastes onion pie, delicious cured pork, and one of the oldest cheeses in the world, kopanisti, still made on the island. In the kitchen, she makes a garlicky local pasta recipe, and a traditional Greek island fish soup.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Athenian Riviera
programme.desc: Gorgeous cafes, bustling nightlife, yachting and water sports, just 20 minutes south of the Greek capital, Athens. Diane visits a fish market where the catch is right off the boat, sails the coast, and returns to her kitchen to create three delicious, contemporary Greek recipes, inspired by the cosmopolitan bustle and fun-loving spirit of the Athenian coast.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Navarino Challenge
programme.desc: Diane and friend and ultramarathoner, Dean Karnazes, meet up for a run. He helps Diane hone her technique, sharing healthy eating tips. Together they make a simple Greek salad with local ingredients and enjoy perfect Mediterranean living. Back in her kitchen, Diane cooks up a very healthy plant-forward Messinian meal, with lots of olive oil, beans and greens.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tasty Teardrops And Tomatoes: Chios
programme.desc: Diane explores everything from beguiling mastiha, to the local pasta to unique tomatoes, dangling like giant rubies against the renowned geometric patterns on medieval houses of Pyrgi. The flavors of historic Chios inspire her to cook up a succulent chicken and quince dish and an easy traditional black eyed pea salad with Mastiha vinaigrette.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Naxos: Meat & Potatoes Like You Never Had'em
programme.desc: Naxos is famed for the quality of its meats, its array of cow's milk and sheep-and-goats' milk cheeses and for its potatoes. Diane heads from the shore straight to a remote mountain hideaway with Alexis in tow, where two local cooks await them with a feast of stuffed lamb, potatoes, and a unique skillet pumpkin-onion pie.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - A Meal In Messinia
programme.desc: Near the historic Bay of Navarino, blanketed by olive, citrus trees and home to historical culinary artifacts unearthed in prehistoric clay tablets at Pylos, Diane cooks with two village ladies, making a local pork and fig dish, and olive-oil fried bread. Inspired by the cornucopia of olive oil, oranges and other local delicacies, she cooks up a Messinian meal.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Evia - An Island Hiding In Plain Sight
programme.desc: The second-largest Greek island and an hour from Athens, Diane heads out in search of mushrooms with a local mushroom forager and cultivator. They cook a favorite local recipe "kritharoto," mushrooms with orzo. Diane makes three delectable dishes with mushrooms, wine and local ingrediants, inspired by the flavors of this nearby "secret" land.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Barcelona: Gaudi, Gin And Gambas
programme.desc: Sara's in Barcelona to sip gin and tonics in the shadow of the iconic Sagreda Familia, then joins a food writer to make classic Iberico Pork with Romanesco sauce and Gambas Ajillo. At home, Sara whips up Fideo - Barcelona's take on Paella made with noodles instead of rice.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Under The Acropolis
programme.desc: Fish is on the menu when Sara joins Greek Chef Maria Loi harborside near Athens to cook lemony, crispy skinned Branzino along with Beet, Beans and Feta Salad and Lemon Potatoes. Then it's off to Athen's Central Market to buy Retsina at a famous tavern for a rooftop mezze party in the shadow of the Acropolis. Back at home, Sara uses canned sardines for a quick and easy pantry taco.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Essential Pastas of Rome
programme.desc: Sara kicks off with a street food tour in Rome led by American Ex Pat Katie Parla. Then, they perform a Roman hat trick - three pastas starting with the same delicious base: Gricia made with guanciale transforms into Amatriciana by adding tomatoes or Carbonara by adding eggs. In her own kitchen, Sara makes baked penne with prosciutto and Fontina cheese.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels - Episode 1
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Enniskillen to meet Pat O'Doherty and his famous pigs. Paul is given a master class in butchery and then travels by boat to see the world famous 'black bacon' pigs run wild on their very own private island!

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels - Episode 2
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to the mighty Thomond Park to cook on the pitch of Munster RFC and meets world rugby legend Doug Howlett. Then it's off to the stunning Adare Village where Paul meets up with his old pal Wade Murphy of 1826 Restaurant.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels - Episode 3
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to the stunning coastal town of Ballycastle in County Antrim, where he visits the beautifully located Ballycastle farmers market and then cooks a fantastic scallop dish on board one of the local boats.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels - Episode 4
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to the breath taking Dursey Island in Cork, home of Irelands only cable car, to learn how to cook fresh scones and jam. After, he cooks up an amazing lobster dish with the Wild Atlantic Way as his backdrop!

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels - Episode 5
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to meet master smoker Paul Curry, later cooking a great dish while gaining exclusive access to one of Irelands most stunning private castles. Then its off to Corick House Hotel & Spa for a spot of foraging and more great recipes!

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels - Episode 6
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Long Meadow Cider company to see how father and son team make their incredible cider.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels - Episode 8
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Killarney and cooks a healthy dish on a jaunting car whilst being whisked through the stunning national Park. Then hikes up Cardiac Hill before having a pint in The Killarney Brewing Company.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels - Episode 9
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Quinns pub in Dungannon to look back at his entire series. We get to see hilarious unseen footage, bloopers and some of Treyvaud's most favorite moments of his amazing travels.

programme.desc: Hottest Burger in The World and Big Ribeye with French Fries

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Quesadilla, Bushcraft Bolognese, World's Hottest Ribeye - Carolina reaper

programme.desc: The bakers get their just dessert as they face three challenges all designed for a sweet tooth.

programme.title: Episode 5: Pies
programme.desc: The bakers attempt to master a hand-raised pie, a perfect wellington and American pies.

programme.title: Episode 6: Puddings
programme.desc: The bakers are take on two types of sponge puddings, a Mary Berry recipe and a showstopping strudel.

programme.title: Episode 7: Sweet Dough

programme.title: Episode 10: The Final

programme.desc: We catch up with last year's bakers, who have come a long way since their time in the tent.

programme.desc: Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry show how the Baking Show challenges should be done.

programme.title: Episode 2
