programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Isabella Roselini (2/1/89)
programme.desc: Isabella Rossellini talks about being raised in France and Italy, plus Martin Short is ready to cook a goose.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Fred Savage (2/2/89)
programme.desc: A 12-year-old Fred Savage "Kind-Of-Sorta" has a girlfriend, plus future host Jay Leno stops by and Brian Gillis does magic

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Jason Bateman (9/27/89)
programme.desc: A young Jason Bateman joins Johnny but might be upstaged by Florence Hodges, a 93-year-old hospital volunteer who shares her amazing stories.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Jennifer Grey (2/2/90)
programme.desc: Jennifer Grey talks about her famous parents. And Carl Reiner talks about his friends Mel Brooks and Steve Martin, and also about....his dog Homer.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Dabney Coleman (5/2/90)
programme.desc: Vodka and Russia are twin themes on this fun episode: Russian comedian Yakov Smirnoff talks about his recent trip home; and Dabney Coleman talks about one of his first jobs--in a vidka commercial!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Judge Reinhold (5/4/90)
programme.desc: Judge Reinhold discusses a nude scene in his latest movie; and Rita Rudner does her brand of stand-up comedy.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - John Larroquette (5/10/90)
programme.desc: John Larroquette tells Johnny how to deal with autograph seekers. Then Johnny tries to do a split with Olympian Kurt Thomas.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - John Larroquette (3/20/91)
programme.desc: John Larroquette is always a fun guest and for his latest appearance he discusses, hair loss, playing the saxophone and...The Weasel Awards. Don't ask!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Barry Levinson (11/14/91)
programme.desc: 96-year-old George Burns says he smokes 15-20 cigars a day. Director Barry Levinson discussed his iconic film "Diner."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Melanie Griffith (1/29/92)
programme.desc: Imagine hearing about Dakota Johnson when she was a baby! Dakota's mom Melanie Griffith is Johnny's guest this week, and she talks about her new baby, and her marriage to Don Johnson.

programme.title: Assassination
programme.desc: Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

programme.title: Murphy's Law
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: At Close Range
programme.desc: A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.

programme.title: State Of Grace
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner, who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programme.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programme.title: The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Steve and Terri Irwin set out to save a crocodile, unaware that it's swallowed a U.S. satellite beacon, and now they're targets of the CIA! Crikey!

programme.title: Walking Tall (2004)
programme.desc: When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: John Woo directs this epic, action-packed drama about a WW II soldier (Nicolas Cage) assigned to protect a Navajo soldier (Adam Beach)...and the secret code he knows. Christian Slater, Roger Willie, Peter Stormare and Mark Ruffalo also star.

programme.title: Hart's War
programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

programme.title: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

programme.title: Flesh + Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

programme.title: RoboCop 2
programme.desc: In this thrilling sequel, Robocop returns to fight his toughest opponent yet...his replacement!

programme.title: RoboCop 3
programme.desc: When a greedy corporation starts evicting families in favor of a very profitable real estate project, RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins with a renegade band of freedom fighters to save them. But RoboCop must also face a new deadly android!

programme.title: German Intelligence in WWII
programme.desc: They were the top spymasters in the Third Reich... two rivals who were shrouded in mystery and sworn to secrecy.

programme.title: The Holocaust Secret
programme.desc: How did the Nazi's hide their atrocities and what did the Allies know as the "final solution" was implemented across Europe?

programme.title: Cold War: Eisenhower's Operatives
programme.desc: The Supreme Allied Commander of World War Two relied on the covert arm of the CIA to an unprecedented scale during his presidency.

programme.title: Cold War: Inside the K.G.B.
programme.desc: Untold stories behind the headlines in the unseen cold war battles between Western intelligence agencies and the KGB.

programme.title: Cold War: Cuba's Communist Revolution
programme.desc: From CIA assassination attempts foiled by Cuban Intelligence agents to Castro's secret pacts with the Soviets and his survival after the Cold War.

programme.title: The Battle of Britain
programme.desc: The men and women who made victory possible in the Battle of Britain.

programme.title: Spy Planes
programme.desc: Examining the secret deployment of aircraft designed to spy from the sky, including the U-2 and the SR-71.

programme.title: D-Day Deceptions
programme.desc: It was the greatest secret of World War Two... the time and place of the D-Day invasion.

programme.title: Prisoners of War, Part One - The Barbed Wire Front
programme.desc: Examines the treatment of prisoners of war early in the 20th century.

programme.title: The O.S.S.
programme.desc: The story of the formation of the Office of Strategic Services, the predecessor to the CIA.

programme.title: Vietnam: Special Operations
programme.desc: As American units fought under rules of engagement imposed by their political leaders, unconventional Special Forces fought classified battles.

programme.title: Tools of Deception
programme.desc: The use of camouflage and instruments of propaganda helped confuse the enemy both on and off the battlefield.

programme.title: Cold War: Cuba's Communist Revolution
programme.desc: From CIA assassination attempts foiled by Cuban Intelligence agents to Castro's secret pacts with the Soviets and his survival after the Cold War.

programme.title: Cold War: Inside the K.G.B.
programme.desc: Untold stories behind the headlines in the unseen cold war battles between Western intelligence agencies and the KGB.

programme.title: The Hunt for Atomic Secrets
programme.desc: The all-important race to develop an atomic bomb led to some of the most daring Russian spy operations in the United States.

programme.title: Bio-Chemical Weapons
programme.desc: Chemical and biological weapons, ranging from the mustard gas artillery shells used in World War I to the U.S. gas stockpiled in the Pacific during WWII and the Iraqi gassing of the Kurds.

programme.title: Vietnam: Alpha Strike
programme.desc: American pilots fought the enemy and their own political leaders in the skies over Vietnam.

programme.title: Nazi Gold
programme.desc: It was a tremendous booty, prized by Hitler as much as territory.

programme.title: Shadows of the Six Day War
programme.desc: Israeli forces, surrounded and outnumbered by the enemy, use covert means to rewrite the map of the Middle East.

programme.title: Super Guns
programme.desc: From Germany's Big Bertha in World War One to Iraq's top secret Project Babylon, they are the ultimate projection of force.

programme.title: The Fall of the Third Reich
programme.desc: Arguably the most pivotal event in modern history, World War II saw mankind forced to evolve and accelerate for the sake of their own survival. The dramatic battle between Hitler and the Allies played out across every continent. This exciting series looks back across some of the most defining moments of WWII brought to a whole new life now in colour. The Battle of Britain was won, but not by Hitler. Hitler had lost the battle. He had lost 2,375 German planes and their crews.

programme.title: Field of Operations: The War in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: On June 10, 1940, Mussolini declared war on France and Britain, leading to battles in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Hitler's Defeat: Victory Against All Odds
programme.desc: The British people's courage and 'Keep Calm and Carry On' attitude led to victory against Hitler. Women took on essential war work, facing evacuation, bombings, and the absence of men at war.

programme.title: Flying Fortress: History of the B-17 Bomber
programme.desc: The B-17, known as the flying fortress, symbolizes U.S. air power. This film explores its history and impact.

programme.title: The Verdict
programme.desc: A duty-conscious corrections officer falls for a younger inmate, helps him escape, leading to a search and media frenzy.

programme.title: Aerial Assault Vietnam
programme.desc: Decades after it ended, the Vietnam War might seem like a distant memory. It was the longest war in American history and the only one from which the USA did not emerge victorious. A greater tonnage of bombs was dropped than in WWII. The war saw helicopters come into their own, transporting troops and supporting air power. For every pilot, there were dozens of support staff. The aerial bombardment of Vietnam remains one of the most staggering sustained attacks in history.

programme.title: Space Force: The Dawn of Galactic Warfare
programme.desc: Space warfare is a major threat. Satellites are vital for society and defense. Explore humanity's space journey and the dawn of galactic warfare.

programme.title: Hitler: Empire of Evil
programme.desc: Hitler's rise to power led to a brutal era in history, leaving a lasting impact on Germany and Europe.

programme.title: Field of Operations: The Battle of Arnhem
programme.desc: The incredible story of one of the most radical ideas of the entire second world war. Operation Market Garden was the plan that caused over 10,000 paratroops to be whittled down to just 2000.

programme.title: Field of Operations: Balkans
programme.desc: Examining the early months of 1941 in the Balkans when Italy's offensive had stalled and a Greek counter-offensive pushed into Albania.

programme.title: Surviving Hitler's Mad Doctors
programme.desc: The Nazi Regime imposed some of the most insane form of eugenics the world has seen. Between 1939 and 1945, at least 70 medical projects, involving cruel and lethal experimentation on human subjects, were conducted in concentration camps.

programme.title: The Korean War: No Longer Forgotten Part I
programme.desc: The Korean War, underestimated yet impactful, forced rapid military advancements amid a fierce ideological battle.

programme.title: As It Happened: Pearl Harbour
programme.desc: Reconstructing the 1941 Pearl Harbour attack with aerial photos and firsthand accounts, this film offers a unique view.

programme.title: Russia at War: Objective Balkans WWII
programme.desc: Hitler's campaign against the U.S.S.R. was initially set for 1943 but moved to 1941 due to British resistance and U.S. opposition.

programme.title: News of War: 1943
programme.desc: Military camera operators capture the raw reality of World War II, revealing heroic victories, battles, and daily life.

programme.title: Prisoners of War, Part One - The Barbed Wire Front
programme.desc: Examines the treatment of prisoners of war early in the 20th century.

programme.title: British Secret Intelligence in WWII
programme.desc: Insight into the British Secret Intelligence Service that demonstrates that facts can indeed be stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Spy Planes
programme.desc: Examining the secret deployment of aircraft designed to spy from the sky, including the U-2 and the SR-71.

programme.title: Cold War: Brezhnev's Kremlin
programme.desc: Before Leonid Brezhnev signed nuclear arms reduction agreements with the West, he led the Soviets into one conflict after another.

programme.title: The Holocaust Secret
programme.desc: How did the Nazi's hide their atrocities and what did the Allies know as the "final solution" was implemented across Europe?

programme.title: Hitler's Last Days
programme.desc: Secret Nazi attempts to turn the tide of war as Berlin crumbled.

programme.title: Nazi Manhunt
programme.desc: The war is over, and the atrocities have been discovered. Thousands of Nazi officers attempt to flee the country, heading towards South America, believing they will find sympathy and evade justice. The allied forces, Britain, France, the United States, and Russia, all agreed to prosecute any living Nazi party officials for the crimes they had committed.

programme.title: Ukraine 2022: Attack on Freedom
programme.desc: Russia's invasion of Ukraine on February 24th, 2022, shocked the world. Despite Putin's claims, Ukraine's spirit endures. President Zelenskyy inspired resilience, and sanctions were imposed on Russia.

programme.title: War in the Sky: The Story of the Royal Air Force
programme.desc: The RAF's journey from WWI to the Cold War, evolving from defense to a tactical force in major conflicts.

programme.title: Military Mayhem In Vietnam II
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a long, costly, and divisive conflict that pitted North Vietnam against South Vietnam and its principal ally, the United States. The Vietcong, familiar with the jungle terrain, used it to their advantage, engaging in hit-and-run guerrilla warfare against inexperienced American soldiers, many of whom were young conscripts.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. programme.desc: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.title: State Property 2
programme.desc: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. His friends invite strippers to the luau and behave in ways that embarrass him. The traveling party winds up leaving without Jack's friends when they fail to show up on time for their flight.

Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: Christmas Together, Friends Forever
programme.desc: A snowy Christmas morning that brings them an unexpected lesson about the true spirit of the holidays.

programme.title: Origins, Part 1

programme.title: Origins, Part 2
programme.desc: The Teens continue their transition into their new lives as Samurai Rangers.

programme.title: Raising Spirits
programme.desc: Glytcher causes havoc as it is disappointed with the level of human participation in Halloween.

programme.title: Ondine
programme.desc: Fisherman Syracuse (Colin Farrell), a recovering alcoholic, lives with his daughter, Annie (Alison Barry), in a small village on the Irish coast. One afternoon, a mystifying and beautiful girl, Ondine (Alicja Bachleda), gets caught in his nets as he wades along the water. Aboard the boat, Ondine brings Syracuse great luck, seemingly drawing the fish towards his nets. However, the fisherman starts to fear that Ondine may not be meant for this life.

programme.title: A Long Way Down
programme.desc: Four strangers who planned to jump off the same roof on New Year's Eve join together as a kind of family and give themselves six weeks to find valid reasons to live.

programme.title: Mr. Nobody: Extended Director's Cut
programme.desc: In 2092, the last mortal human on Earth reflects on his long past and thinks about the lives he might have led.

programme.title: Please Stand By
programme.desc: Wendy sees things differently: she's fiercely independent, with a brilliant mind and a mischievous sense of hilarity. Wendy also has autism. To her, people are an indecipherable code and the world's a confusing place. Inspired by her no-nonsense caregiver, Wendy comes of age and escapes from her care home on the road trip of a lifetime to deliver her 500-page script to a writing competition.

programme.title: Prince Avalanche
programme.desc: Two road-crew workers (Paul Rudd, Emile Hirsch) spend the summer of 1988 isolated and away from their city lives, eventually finding themselves at odds with each other and their women back home.

programme.title: Nobody Walks
programme.desc: A young woman's (Olivia Thirlby) arrival sparks a surge of energy into a laid-back, artistic Los Angeles household, forcing the residents to confront their own fears and desires in an intricate dance of lust, denial and deception.

programme.title: Main Street
programme.desc: A stranger (Colin Firth) becomes involved with the close-knit residents of a North Carolina town after he arrives with a controversial plan to save their crumbling community.

programme.title: Compliance
programme.desc: A fast-food worker (Dreama Walker) who's accused of theft is put through the wringer as her boss (Ann Dowd), at the direction of a phone caller who says he's a cop, subjects her to increasingly harsh forms of interrogation.
A man (Anthony Hopkins) searches for his missing daughter in one of several vignettes dealing with issues of love, loss and betrayal.

programme.title: Lucky
programme.desc: A 90-year-old atheist has outlived and out-smoked his contemporaries, and as he comes to terms with his own mortality, he searches for ever-elusive enlightenment.

programme.title: Then She Found Me
programme.desc: Life deals a few heavy blows to April (Helen Hunt), a 39-year-old schoolteacher. Though she is desperate for a baby, her husband (Matthew Broderick) has decided to end their brief marriage. April barely has a chance to recover from the shock, when Bernice (Bette Midler), a brassy and selfish TV personality, barges into her life, claiming to be her mother.

programme.title: Touchy Feely
programme.desc: A dentist (Josh Pais) gains the ability to heal his patients' physical pain while his sister (Rosemarie DeWitt), a massage therapist, develops an aversion to touching and being touched.

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: As a planet hurtles toward a collision course with Earth, two sisters (Kirsten Dunst, Charlotte Gainsbourg) cope with the approaching doomsday in different ways.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Though a misfit among his brainy family members, Massachusetts bouncer Doug Glatt has a knockout punch that lands him a spot on a minor-league Canadian hockey team.

programme.title: Tucker & Dale vs Evil
programme.desc: Two scruffy pals' (Tyler Labine, Alan Tudyk) backwoods vacation takes a bloody turn when ignorant college students mistake them for a pair of murderous hillbillies.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: Life Partners
programme.desc: A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.

programme.title: Flawless
programme.desc: A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: Harper (Tye Sheridan), a seemingly naive law student, obsesses over the idea that his shifty stepfather (Stephen Moyer) was involved in the devastating car crash that left his mother hospitalized and comatose. While drowning his suspicions in whiskey, he suddenly finds himself engrossed in a conversation with a volatile grifter (Emory Cohen) and his stripper companion (Bel Powley). As daylight breaks, Harper soon realizes that he's in over his head with this violent duo.

programme.title: Humboldt County
programme.desc: Aspiring doctor Peter Hadley (Jeremy Strong) gets the shock of his life when his hard-nosed father (Peter Bogdanovich) -- and medical-school professor -- fails him, invalidating his acceptance to an elite residency program. His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

programme.title: Ceremony
programme.desc: An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.

programme.title: Filth
programme.desc: A drug-addled, manipulative misanthrope (James McAvoy) begins to experience increasingly severe hallucinations as he tries to solve the murder of a Japanese student.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Four Lions
programme.desc: A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

programme.title: Swan Song

programme.title: ProCharged Mustang

programme.title: Improve Horsepower and Torque: High-Performance Tips For LS Engines

programme.title: Chevy K1500 5.3 LS Swap

programme.title: Low-Fi S-10: New Audio System & Interior

programme.title: Jeep Wagoneer Transformed: "TrashHawk" Hits The Track
programme.desc: After completing final work on our TrackHawk inspired 1986 Jeep Wagoneer we call TrashHawk, it's time for some high performance fun at the National Corvette Museum Motorsports Park track.

programme.title: Custom Cooling, Custom Exhaust, The Test Sled Build is On!
programme.desc: Our rolling dyno sled receives a fuel system, intercooler, and hand-built exhaust. Plus: take a visit inside Dustless Blasting's manufacturing facility.

programme.title: Adding More Power to the Rally Car's 4 Cylinder
programme.desc: We do a little wrenching on our Honda 4 cylinder. Updating some key components and sealing up some oil leaks. Plus, the Civic gets a facelift with a Rally Car inspired paint job.

programme.title: Tearing Down a Pair of 351 Small Blocks: Windsor vs Cleveland
programme.desc: HorsePower goes on a salvage yard treasure hunt and finds a pair of 351 smallblocks -- Cleveland and Windsor. After twin teardowns, exploring the characteristics of each, the guys start the first of two performance build-ups.

programme.title: Easy Upgrades for a Stock Big Block Chevy
programme.desc: It's not all about horsepower! We take a Chevy 454 big block and dial in hard-hauling, heavy-pulling torque.

programme.title: Stage 2 Ram Wrap-Up
programme.desc: Final top end mods, rear locker & traction bars installed before our 1 ton dually hits the strip.

programme.title: Project Shell Shock - Brakes, Wiring & More!
programme.desc: This week on our '56 Chevy 210 Gasser, we're checking a few more things off the list. We'll install new brake pads, drop in some fresh taillights, and show you a few wiring tips to help keep things clean and simple. We're also adding power windows for a little extra comfort, and giving our interior trim panels a quick facelift with some fresh paint. It's all about knocking out the details that make this classic that much better.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 8 - Power Moves
programme.desc: Wired and inspired - The guys enter the winding maze of wiring as they install a new ECU. Then, it's out with the old and in with the new as Joel upgrades the sound deadening and Tommy puts a new shine on the original taillights.

programme.title: Project Struck Out
programme.desc: As Tommy and Peyton resume work on their 1966 Chevy Nova, they suddenly learn that this project may go from Starstruck to Struck Out. With that, they switch gears into another historic muscle car, 1969 Pontiac GTO.

programme.title: Modern 410ci Stroker Windsor with Custom EFI & Coil-Near-Plug Conversion - Part 2
programme.desc: We're expecting great numbers in the dyno cell for the 410ci Small Block Ford, after it receives an aggressive intake manifold, a custom coil-on-plug conversion, and a powerful EFI system!

programme.title: Ford F-150: Preparation F
programme.desc: Today, we're prepping a big-block Ford to go in our big blue F-150. We'll walk you through the ins and outs of any and everything you'll need to plumb an entire fuel injection system from sump to solenoids.

programme.title: Sierra HD Duramax Allison Transmission
programme.desc: We'll show you the step-by-step inner workings of an Allison transmission when our guys build the gearbox for a Sierra HD Duramax.

programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: The good-hearted Sprinter Galore is back at his home planet, battling evil villains bent.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happil

programme.title: Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie's photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn't stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer

programme.title: Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready - steady - and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK - ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there's a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Ryan Defrates
programme.desc: The Adventures of Ryan Defrates: Secret Agent is about a young spy with a whole lot to learn, who is paired with a very unlikely partner... his mom!

programme.title: Monsuno
programme.desc: The series revolves around re-awakened Monster DNA, called Monsuno, that finds its way into the unsuspecting hands of adventure-seeking teenagers Chase, Jinja, and Bren. Accompanied by their Monsuno, Lock, Charger, and Quickforce, they are searching for Chase's father Jeredy Suno, the creator of the Monsuno

programme.title: Plum the Super Witch
programme.desc: Plum is a perfectly normal 6-year-old witch who lives fun adventures trying to stop Elizandra from destroying her city.

programme.title: Invent'Tom
programme.desc: Meet Tom, Car City's very own inventor! In his high-tech lab, he creates the wackiest inventions to solve his friend's problems.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Things get even more epic in Season 3 as Talking Tom and Friends try new ways to make their dreams come true, making more friends (and enemies) along the way!

programme.title: Pincode - Nano Bots
programme.desc: Wally is sick, and it's up to the rest of the crew to find out what's wrong. Dokko and Carlin want to create tiny nano robots to help Wally fight his illness. In this episode, kids learn about white blood cells, and how they work to attack viruses.

programme.title: Pincode - Metapumpkin
programme.desc: Barry has grown a giant pumpkin, but he's worried that the caterpillars will eat it before it's ripe. Krash and his friends form one team to ward off the caterpillars with force, and Dokko and the others form another team to use careful planning to keep the caterpillars away. Which method will work? In this episode, kids learn about molecular self assembly.

programme.title: The Journey Home
programme.desc: This story is about Mick, a sleeping chironomid. Insects are taken up into space for use in experiments by humans. An epic space adventure of Mick and his friends of their journey back home to Earth!

programme.title: Babies in Car City
programme.desc: The Babies are curious little cars whose sense of wonder always leads them into fantastic adventures-and sometimes trouble!

programme.title: Super Truck
programme.desc: Carl the Super Truck and his gadgets to the rescue! When the residents of Car City need help, this superhero jumps into action.

programme.title: Grojband
programme.desc: The story about 12 year old Corey that emotionally torments his sister so that she will write the ultimate lyrics for his garage band.

programme.title: MINITUNS
programme.desc: MINITUNS presents an exciting and fun selection of children's songs, perfect to enjoy, dance and sing with the family. A world full of colors and melodies, designed to teach counting, care for the planet and enjoy the game.

programme.title: AnimaCars
programme.desc: Jonny and the Rescue Team work hard to maintain peace. Every day there's a new challenge, every day a new chance for adventure.

programme.title: Construction Squad
programme.desc: The Construction Squad builds Car City brick by brick! They're proof that everything's possible with a little help from our friends.

programme.title: One Zeez
programme.desc: The One Zeez make music as they explore our world, learning to stomp like a dinosaur, flip like a shark and jiggle like skeletons.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Winx Club is a fantasy saga revolving around six fairies and their adventures. The protagonists Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna and Musa live their daily life on Magix world, among lessons, loves, quarrels and moments of strong friendship. At any moment, when needed, they can transform into super-heroines, ready to defeat evil and save who is in danger.

programme.title: Horrible look
programme.desc: Tomás finge ser un ejecutivo y le dice a Alicia que es el gerente de Filmo Imagen; Marcia y Alicia encuentran una fotografía de Patricia Manterola en bikini entre las cosas de Fernando.

programme.title: Totalmente enamorada
programme.desc: Adrianita cuestiona a Lola sobre su divorcio; Simón festeja a los niños; Luigi regaña a Jazmín por no hacer bien su trabajo; Efrén entra a Conceptos enyesado y con muletas.

programme.title: Intuición
programme.desc: Fernando intenta demostrarle a Marcia que no tiene ninguna amante; Eduardo le dice a Fernando que intuye que Marcia lo ama.

programme.title: Celebración cumpleañera
programme.desc: Omar le aconseja a Fernando salir con Lety para festejar su cumpleaños; Eduardo le dice a Fernando que Lety lo quiere y lo respeta, de modo que él debe valorarla.

programme.title: Última esperanza
programme.desc: José reconoce a Eduardo y permite el acceso a las del cuartel; Eduardo le pide al mariachi que cante; Marcia regaña a Alicia por coquetearle a Tomás; Lola y Efrén discuten frente a la juez.

programme.title: Apuesta inútil
programme.desc: Irmita le dice a Jazmín que Lola y Efrén deberán repartirse los bienes; Alicia se empieza a portar muy amable con Eduardo cuando se entera de que tiene dinero, incluso, apuesta con Luigi que lo va a conquistar.

programme.title: Cena de cumpleaños
programme.desc: Marcia siente que Fernando pone muchos pretextos para no ir con ella y le pide a Alicia que lo siga; Lety les dice a las del cuartel que saldrá a festejar con Tomás y le confiesa a Eduardo que está enamorada de Tomás.

programme.title: Invitación a cenar
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le reclama a Tomás por la cuenta del celular y se niega a pagarla; Lety se ve obligada a invitar a Marcia al festejo, pero ella se niega.

programme.title: Conviviendo con la familia
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando van juntos a un bar y Alicia se disfraza para espiarlos; Tomás juega billar con Sánchez y Rosales.

programme.title: Cita frustrada
programme.desc: Alicia le dice a Marcia que sospecha que Fernando fue a una casa de citas; Julieta y Don Erasmo le presumen a Fernando todos los logros académicos de Lety.

programme.title: Después de la fiesta
programme.desc: Román y un joven se suben al automóvil de Marcia y Alicia y reciben una rociada de gas pimienta; se arma un escándalo y todos son llevados a la delegación para aclarar la situación.

programme.title: Noche de amor
programme.desc: Fernando lleva a Lety a un hotel y hacen el amor por primera vez. Fernando no ama a Lety, pero sabe que fue una noche muy especial.

programme.title: Remordimientos
programme.desc: Paula María le cuenta a Lety sobre su noche con Simón; Jazmín se enoja con Efrén porque no quiere pedir la mitad de la casa de Lola; Fernando intenta explicarle a Lety que no pasó nada entre él y Marcia en el departamento.

programme.title: Por el bien de la empresa
programme.desc: Jazmín se niega a salir con Efrén, acepta la invitación de Simón y apaga el celular; Lety se atraganta al escuchar a Lola decir que la cuestionó Marcia; Alicia cuelga el teléfono cuando Román la reconoce.

programme.title: Compromisos obligados
programme.desc: Alicia se niega a empeñar sus joyas y su automóvil. Fernando pone a Carolina, Marcia, Luigi y Omar al tanto de las nuevas contrataciones. Luigi menciona la boda entre Fernando y Marcia, de modo que Lety se pone triste.

programme.title: Hermano despechado
programme.desc: Efrén le dice a Jazmín que pedirá la mitad de la casa de Lola; Ariel amenaza a Fernando con pedir la disolución de la empresa si no se casa con Marcia.

programme.title: Continúa el plan de boda
programme.desc: Fernando le declara su amor a Lety y le pide que se queden juntos; Martha le confiesa a Paco que la liposucción no le sirvió de nada, pero él le asegura que la quiere así.

programme.title: Artista de visita
programme.desc: Lety se emociona al leer la tarjeta que Fernando le dejó; Simón lleva a Patricia Manterola a conocer al personal de Conceptos y Alicia le avisa a Marcia de inmediato.

programme.title: Evento en el museo de cera
programme.desc: Alicia le aconseja a Marcia ir tras Patricia Manterola; Omar le dice a Fernando que Lety salió destrozada de la oficina. Fernando acepta que Luigi trabaje para Patricia Manterola. Marcia, Omar y Fernando viajan a Alemania.

programme.title: Escape del museo
programme.desc: Leticia y el Cuartel de las Feas asisten al museo de cera. Marcia y Alicia van para tratar de descubrir a Fernando con su amante y Omar le aconseja a Fernando seducir de nuevo a Lety.

programme.title: Dulce despedida
programme.desc: Alicia le sugiere a Marcia buscar a Fernando; Omar le ofrece su departamento a Fernando para llevar a Lety; Paula María se molesta porque escucha a Simón decirle a Celso que saldrán con unas chicas.

programme.title: La apuesta
programme.desc: Román y sus amigos interceptan a Alicia y le reclaman por sus mentiras; Lety le recuerda a Fernando sobre la llegada de Miguel y la apuesta que hizo con Román.

programme.title: Prioridades
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Alicia que no quiere viajar con Fernando quien le confiesa a Omar que ya no quiere seguir engañando a Lety porque ella lo ama.

programme.title: Recocimiento merecido
programme.desc: Román le deja un recado por teléfono a Alicia; Fernando impide que Lety se vaya; Luigi ofende a las del cuartel, Cristina se molesta con él y lo obliga a que se las presente.

programme.title: Borrón y cuenta nueva
programme.desc: Fernando le da a Lety un regalo y una tarjeta donde le pide olvidar el pasado y volver a tener fe; Fernando y Marcia se despiden. Marcia invita a comer a Lety para sacarle información.

programme.title: Bolsa misteriosa
programme.desc: Simón se lleva a los niños y Efrén se lo reclama a Lola, pero ella le hace ver que Paco y Simón han sido mejores padres que él; Lety se niega a contarles a las del cuartel lo que habló con Marcia.

programme.title: Venganza cobrada
programme.desc: El chisme de que Fernando se peleó llega a oídos del cuartel. Los papás de Fernando le piden a Lety que arregle el regalo de bodas.

programme.title: La bolsa perdida
programme.desc: Omar urge a Fernando que encuentre la bolsa roja, pues si cae en manos equivocadas, se sabrá todo lo que han ocultado para salvar la empresa: Fernando le dice a Sara que la bolsa tiene muestras para laboratorio.

programme.title: Confusión total
programme.desc: Fernando confunde a Marcia con Lety por teléfono; Marcia le dice a Fernando que no lo quiere perder, Lety se convence de dejarlo ir.

programme.title: Falsas acusaciones
programme.desc: Alicia cuestiona a las del cuartel y culpa a Juanita de haber tomado la bolsa; Matilde intenta besar a Tomás durante la filmación, pero él le dice que se casará con Leticia.

programme.title: El Cuartel en acción
programme.desc: Luigi se va a Alemania para filmar el comercial de Sport Wing; Fernando le entrega a Lety un dibujo que le hizo; Lety habla por teléfono en clave con Teresita para explicarle su encargo.

programme.title: Los nuevos productores
programme.desc: Fernando deja su automóvil a media calle para ir tras Lety; las del cuartel se encargan de conseguir lo necesario para filmar el comercial; Raúl y Simón hacen la audición a las modelos.

programme.title: Cambio de giro
programme.desc: Se lleva a cabo en Conceptos la audición de las modelos en traje de baño, y Alicia decide que ella quiere ser la modelo del comercial y hará todo para conseguirlo.

programme.title: Equipo eficiente
programme.desc: Efrén busca a Jazmín y Fernando le pide a Simón que le ayude a encontrarla; Paula María logra que Pilar Zacarías, la modelo a la que quería contratar Luigi, se presente en Conceptos.

programme.title: Todo casi listo
programme.desc: El cuartel de las feas trata de complacer los deseos de Pilar para la realización del comercial y Lety le dice que Fernando tiene una doble vida.

programme.title: Batalla de supermercado
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le cuelga a Matilde; Alicia y Pilar chocan sus carritos en el supermercado; Lety le cuenta a Fernando por qué nunca aprendió a cocinar y él acepta que tampoco sabe.

programme.title: Romance interrumpido
programme.desc: Julieta le aclara a Matilde que es la esposa de don Erasmo, ella se disculpa y sale en busca de Tomás; Fernando le dice a Lety que se siente muy bien con ella y después atiende una llamada de Marcia.

programme.title: Fuera de la oficina
programme.desc: Fernando le cuenta a Omar cómo le fue con Lety; Alicia se queja con Marcia porque Fernando no la deja filmar el comercial y conseguir el dinero que necesita para pagar su deuda.

programme.title: Filmación caótica
programme.desc: Pilar se niega a filmar una subida en un caballo, un guardia impide que Alicia entre al club; don Riquelme y su acompañante le enseñan a don Erasmo a jugar golf.

programme.title: Cambios de último minuto
programme.desc: Gerardo le dice a Fernando que habrá problemas con el color del vestuario de las modelos. Ricardo llega a la locación y presenta a Francisco Riquelme como el cliente del comercial.

programme.title: Plan de diva
programme.desc: Fernando, Ricardo y Gerardo siguen el plan dictado por Luigi; el señor Riquelme y su acompañante llegan al bar con don Erasmo; Alicia espía el cámper de Pilar y Tomás la espía a ella.

programme.title: Sabotaje exitoso
programme.desc: Don Erasmo regaña a Lety por dejar que la abracen y le pide a Fernando que le ayude a cuidarla, pues al parecer anda en malos pasos y Tomás está en el club.

programme.title: Confesiones
programme.desc: Pilar le cuenta a su amiga que Fernando aceptó ser Pavel, pero que se dio cuenta de que ya no lo quiere; Lety cuestiona a Fernando y Pilar le dice lo que le confesó.

programme.title: No más mentiras
programme.desc: Lety intenta que su padre entienda la farsa entre Sara y Fernando, por lo que debe decirle la verdad que le ocultó cuando entró a Conceptos; Fernando le cuenta a Julieta cómo se unió el cuartel para que saliera el comercial.

programme.title: Miedo a volar
programme.desc: Alicia entra a la oficina de Fernando, pero él la corre porque sabe que solo quiere obtener información; Ricardo le da instrucciones a Fernando para cuando estén en Alemania.

programme.title: Afición futbolera
programme.desc: Fernando y Lety se hospedan en un hotel en Alemania; en la agencia de publicidad, Fernando y Lety se enteran de que ya se firmó el contrato con otra empresa.

programme.title: El mundial
programme.desc: Marcia escucha las voces de Toño de Valdés y Omar Chaparro y empieza a dudar de Fernando; Lety y Fernando reciben un boleto para el partido de fútbol.

programme.title: Viaje de ensueño
programme.desc: Fernando y Lety se la han pasado de maravilla. Sin embargo, don Humberto le reclama a Lety que no se comunicara con ellos y que no le haya enviado el video que le encargó.

programme.title: El sobre misterioso
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Omar lo nerviosa que se puso Lety cuando la encontró en postproducción y él le sugiere ver el DVD de Lety, quien le encarga a Simón mandar un sobre a Londres.

programme.title: Sólo para mujeres
programme.desc: Marcia se enoja con Fernando porque siente que la está engañando. Alicia se queja con Rubén porque las del cuartel se van a un show solo para mujeres y él le recomienda que las acompañe.

programme.title: La madrastra
programme.desc: Efrén presenta a Jazmín con Cuco y Adrianita, quienes la recuerdan como La Demostradora. A pesar de los problemas con Lola, Efrén le pide que intente mantener una buena relación con los niños.

programme.title: Amor eterno
programme.desc: Alicia logra entrar al show solo para mujeres; Simón, vestido de mujer, es obligado a subir al escenario; los niños destrozan la casa de Efrén y Jazmín lucha con todas sus fuerzas para no enojarse.

programme.title: Desconcierto
programme.desc: Don Erasmo invita a Sánchez y Rosales a tomarse un trago; Lety se desconcierta cuando Fernando no le contesta el teléfono a Marcia; Efrén lleva a los niños a casa de Lola.

programme.title: Inseguridades
programme.desc: Fernando sale a un restaurante con Lety y ella piensa que le da pena que lo vean con ella porque pide una mesa en el lugar más íntimo. Por otro lado, Julieta le pide a la Virgen que proteja a Lety.

programme.title: Obligaciones que cumplir
programme.desc: Lety se niega a hacer el amor con Fernando y le propone que hasta que los dos sean libres para amarse lo hagan. Fernando decide no terminar con Marcia.

programme.title: Enojo y decepción
programme.desc: Marcia recibe un anillo de compromiso por parte de Fernando. Lety descubre la carta que le dejó Omar a Fernando con instrucciones para conquistarla.

programme.title: Mercedes Randall vs. Aaron Tichenor
programme.desc: Mercedes says she's come to Divorce Court to give Aaron an ultimatum. She says Aaron, who has become a social media influencer, cares more about his persona than their six-year relationship. She wants him to give up his dream of becoming the next Kardashian, or risk losing her forever. Aaron says Mercedes is jealous of his 3 million social media followers, and instead of complaining about his persona, she should accept him and the benefits that come with dating a "star.

programme.title: Latina Yildiz vs. Marvin Brown
programme.desc: Latina says Marvin has abandoned her and their family for his music career. She wants Marvin to get "real" about his chances of being a successful musician and turn his focus to loving her and supporting their family. Marvin says it's Latina's lack of support and disrespect towards him, and his music, that has caused a rift between them. Can Judge Faith help this couple wrap up their toxic ways or will Marvin end up losing his family for the rap game?

programme.title: Paris Parks vs. Devante McNeal
programme.desc: Paris says Devante's lack of responsibility and concern for her well-being is driving a wedge in their 10-year relationship. She says if Devante doesn't fix his behavior, she's taking their daughter and moving on with her life. Devante says he's tired of Paris' spending money on her shopping addiction and disrespecting him in front of their family and friends. He says she needs to clean up her act and fast!

programme.title: Terrill Jones vs. Sarah Williams
programme.desc: Terrill says Sarah's behavior is inexcusable. He claims she's had numerous sexual encounters with other men and has even found evidence on her phone that prove his allegations. Terrill says he wants Sarah to act like wife material and not an out-of-control teenager. Sarah says Terrill won't admit his past infidelities but keeps a score card on all her mistakes. She also claims he tries to control everything, from what she wears to where she goes.

programme.title: Trinety Mullen vs. Kentrell Warren
programme.desc: Trinety says her husband, Kentrell, is a liar, a cheater, and an alcoholic who refuses to keep a job. She wants him to sign the divorce papers, so she can move on with her life. Kentrell claims it's Trinety who is liar! He argues that she constantly belittles him and accuses him of cheating when he's done nothing wrong. Can Judge Faith give this couple the tools they need to save their marriage or is it far too little and too late to try anymore?

programme.title: Catrina Griffin vs. "Keyon" Bell
programme.desc: Catrina says for seven years, she's put up with "Keyon's" suspicious behavior and today she wants answers. She says his paychecks don't reflect the time he claims to be working, which is why she has strong suspicions he may be living a double life, possibly even with another family. "Keyon" says he's done with Catrina's lack of trust in him and is unsure if he should continue this relationship.

programme.title: Dianca Glamour vs. "Kilo" Allen
programme.desc: Dianca says "Kilo" is no longer the man she fell in love with. She suspects "Kilo" has started transitioning into a woman, which has changed his behavior altogether. "Kilo" says he's sacrificed too much of his time, energy, and money on his relationship just for Dianca to throw him away like he's worthless. He says Dianca is the one that's moved on with other people and is the reason she's making up these allegations.

programme.title: Eleazar "Eli" Rodriguez vs. Nohariz "Iris" Rodriguez
programme.desc: Eleazar "Eli" says his wife is a verbally abusive freeloading alcoholic who undermines his parenting. He says if his wife doesn't curb her bad attitude and behavior, and start contributing her fair share to the household, their marriage is over. Iris says her husband's emotional distance has caused problems in their marriage. She says she doesn't feel supported or heard in this marriage.

programme.title: Arika Martin vs. Ashley Rushing
programme.desc: From late night calls to disappearing acts, Arika says she's reached a breaking point with her fiancée Ashley. Arika says if Ashley isn't willing to commit and respect their vows, their relationship is over. Ashley says she's exhausted from trying to prove that she's not spending every spare minute sneaking around behind Arika's back. Can Judge Faith help prevent this couple from playing each other?

programme.title: David Fox vs. Dionne Sanders
programme.desc: David says his wife Dionne is emotionally and financially disrespectful, and he is certain she has physically stepped out on their marriage. He wants his wife to start treating him with more respect or he will leave the relationship. Dionne says she's fed up with David's jealousy and wants him to get it under control before it's too late. Can Judge Faith provide new life to this dying marriage?

programme.title: Aaliyah Hardeman vs. Robert Nellums
programme.desc: Aaliyah says that Robert is a compulsive liar and cheater. Aaliyah says she's too good of a woman to be lied to and cheated on and wants Robert to come clean once and for all. Robert says that Aaliyah is a horrible communicator who is constantly disrespecting him. Both want to know if their relationship can be salvaged. Can Judge Faith rekindle their love and trust or is too late?

programme.title: Jade Wyatt vs. Devonta "Deeman" Reid
programme.desc: Jade suspects Devonta "Deeman" is using his YouTube comedian persona as an excuse to cheat with other females. She says Deeman's ego has taken over their relationship, and she's had enough. Devonta "Deeman" says Jade is way too entitled and expects him to buy her expensive gifts and be the sole provider. Can these two work things out or will their frustrations get the better of them?

programme.title: Teresa Santeramo vs. Justin Wilkerson
programme.desc: Teresa says she feels alone in her marriage and is ready to call it quits. She says Justin is cheating on her and doesn't support her when it comes to co-parenting. Justin says he's exhausted with Teresa's cheating accusations and lack of communication. Can this couple learn to swim, or will this relationship end up sinking like a rock?

programme.title: Dominique Henderson vs. Cody Campbell
programme.desc: Dominique says she's tired of Cody allowing his family to meddle in their lives. She also claims she's found a video of a woman twerking and pictures of half-naked women in his phone. Dominique says Cody has one more chance to make it right or their relationship is over. Cody says Dominique needs to accept that his family isn't going anywhere, and that his suspicious behavior is all in her head. Does Judge Faith have a big enough gavel to keep this case under control?

programme.title: Michael Taylor vs. Shanna Mcdaniel
programme.desc: Michael says he's tired of Shanna constantly accusing him of cheating, her comparing him to her ex-boyfriends, as well as her out-of-control drinking habits. Shanna wants Michael, who is a rapper, to lose the groupies and be more committed to their relationship or she's calling it quits! Can Judge Faith pry these two out from between a rock and hard place?

programme.title: Tamira Jackson vs. Steven McGaughy
programme.desc: Tamira says Steven is a habitual liar and cheater, and she is ready to move on if he's not willing to get his life in order. She says she's tired of women showing up unexpectedly at their home and claiming he fathered their children. Steven argues it's Tamira's lack of trust and inability to support his dreams of making it in the music industry is the main reason for their falling out. Can Judge Faith Jenkins provide this couple one last lifeline or will this relationship go to the dogs?

programme.title: Antonett Wilson vs. Miguel Thompson
programme.desc: Antonett says she's tired of Miguel bailing out on their relationship when things get tough. She says Miguel acts like he's single, pawns all their belongings, and constantly accusing her of cheating and claiming their two-year-old son isn't his child. Miguel says he has every right to demand a DNA test on Antonett's son. He claims he's constantly finding her talking to other men and even kissing other women. Will Judge Faith be able to get them to control their reckless love?

programme.title: Latosha "Tosha" Thomas vs. Ferdinand "Freddy" Thomas
programme.desc: Latosha "Tosha" wants Ferdinand "Freddy" to understand his addiction to porn and the turmoil it causes on their relationship. "Tosha" says it's "Freddy's" refusal to be intimate with her that has caused their marriage to fall apart. "Freddy" says he's tired of "Tosha's" excuses for stepping out with other men and needs her to understand what she did isn't okay. Can Judge Faith help mend these two broken hearts or is this relationship already lost?

programme.title: Ebony Strothers vs. Kenneth Walker
programme.desc: Ebony is fed up with Kenneth acting like a man who is single! Ebony says Kenneth is constantly blaming "work" for the reason he's not around and hanging out with other women. Kenneth says he's tired of constantly trying to prove his innocence and says their relationship would thrive if Ebony would stop snooping around. Can Judge Faith perform some magic and resolve this messy quarrel?

programme.title: Kayla Anderson vs. Antione Anderson
programme.desc: Kayla says Antione has failed to provide for their family and abandoned them multiple times. She's willing to give him a second chance but needs him to prove that he can be a reliable partner and financial provider to their family, and quit bailing out whenever another woman gives him attention. Antione says Kayla needs to be more patient and stop flying off the handle every time there's a disagreement between them. Can Judge Faith save this hurting marriage?

programme.title: April Walls vs. Keith Walls
programme.desc: April says she wants her husband, Keith, to come clean once and for all. She says he's never been honest about how he sees other women on the side. She also claims he's an alcoholic who's not financially responsible. Keith argues April not only nags about every little thing but also wants to lead the marriage and be the man in the relationship. He says if she would let him be the man in their marriage, they could live a much happier life.

programme.title: Mavia Clemon vs. Lenoris "Lee" Starks
programme.desc: Mavia says "Lee's" controlling ways are keeping them from being truly happy. She claims he refuses to let her buy her own clothes, constantly makes her feel inferior, and must always know where she's at. "Lee" says if Mavia wants this relationship to work, she needs to be more submissive. Can this over-controlled relationship be salvaged?

programme.title: Janeil Munoz vs. Rico Williams
programme.desc: Janeil says she's tired of being the breadwinner and the only one in her relationship to take commitment seriously. She says Rico is a lazy cheater, who needs to either step up or leave her alone once and for all. Rico says Janiel is a drama queen who's too easily influenced by outside voices and needs to stop listening to other people. Does Judge Faith have what it takes to save this couple or is this relationship doomed?

programme.title: Nicole Borden vs. Antonio Borden (Part 1)
programme.desc: After 14 years of marriage, Nicole says she's come to Divorce Court to get her life back! She says her husband, Antonio, is a serial cheater who had multiple children outside of their marriage and she no longer wishes to continue being with him. Antonio admits to his mistakes in the past but wants to save his marriage and needs Nicole to hear him out one last time. Is it possible for this marriage to be saved?

programme.title: Nicole Borden vs. Antonio Borden (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 14 years of marriage, Nicole says she's come to Divorce Court to get her life back! She says her husband, Antonio, is a serial cheater who had multiple children outside of their marriage and she no longer wishes to continue being with him. Antonio admits to his mistakes in the past but wants to save his marriage and needs Nicole to hear him out one last time. Is it possible for this marriage to be saved?

programme.title: Chnise Herron vs. Kelisha Amos
programme.desc: Chenise says she no longer knows the person she met 7 years ago. She says not only does she suspect Kelisha is cheating on her but believes she may be in another relationship after she introduced Chenise as her "roommate." Kelisha refutes it's Chenise, not her, who pretends to live as a single woman. Can Judge Faith provide this couple the strength they need to see through this dip, or is this the beginning of the end?

programme.title: Stacie Winchester vs. Keenan Deal
programme.desc: Stacie says she feels stuck in her relationship with Keenan who she describes as a narcissist, a liar, and a cheater. She wants him to start being faithful or lose her forever. Keenan says Stacie neglects him as a man, partner, and entrepreneur. He wants her to accept his line of work and start believing in him. Can Judge Faith Jenkins help them find some middle ground or before this relationship falls apart?

programme.title: Susan Taylor vs. John Cotugno
programme.desc: Susan says that for the last eight years, she's put up with John's poker addiction, their intimacy issues, and his financial irresponsibility! At 51 years old, she says she's no longer willing to wait for John to get his act together. John says he's tired of Susan's controlling behavior and he's here to finally stand up for himself. Is Judge Faith willing to bet on this couple or is it time to for them to fold and walk away?

programme.title: Bella Nicole Rose vs. Kenneth D. Golatt
programme.desc: Bella says she's had enough of Kenneth keeping her and their relationship a secret. She suspects Kenneth may even have another family. She wants the truth today...no matter what! Kenneth says Bella is too demanding and controlling over his life. Will Judge Faith give the guidance this shattered couple needs to move forward?

programme.title: Joseph Arnold vs. Tiffany Solomon
programme.desc: Joseph has one foot out the door unless Tiffany can curb her spending habits and partying lifestyle. Tiffany needs Joseph to understand if he doesn't want to have more kids with her then she will keep spending his money. She refuses to sit home all day and night without the promise of growing their family. Does Judge Faith have what it takes to help lead this couple down a happier path?

programme.title: Christina Smalls vs. George Artis
programme.desc: Christina says she's no longer interested in staying with George if he's going to continue to deal with other women and doesn't take the steps to level-up our life together. George wants Christina to admit to her drinking problem and have more trust in him. Will Judge Faith implore this relationship to be more committed to each other's needs or is it far too little, too late?

programme.title: Inia Withers vs. Nathaniel "Nate" Smith
programme.desc: Inia says her marriage is over and there's nothing "Nate" can say or do to change that. Inia says "Nate" is no longer interested in being intimate with her and suspects another woman may be the reason. "Nate" says Inia treats him like a child instead of her husband and he's had enough. Can Judge Faith Jenkins restore the lost passion and respect in this relationship?

programme.title: Marlayna Lester vs. Ronald Lester
programme.desc: Marlayna says her husband, Ronald, has betrayed her on multiple occasions and is now living with his "roommate" named Shatara. Ronald argues he's innocent and says Marlayna's jealousy and insecurity is the reason their marriage over. Can Judge Faith steer this fractured vessel of a marriage away from the rocks or is it too late?

programme.title: Dahlia Turnbull vs. Noah Healy
programme.desc: After discovering Noah's true nature and secret life, Dahlia says there's no turning back. Dahlia fears that for the last three years she's been in a committed relationship with a habitual liar and she's calling it quits. Noah says Dahlia allows her fears and suspicions to get in the way of their happiness. Can Judge Faith provide the support this relationship desperately needs?

programme.title: Michael Kelly vs. Chasity Williams
programme.desc: Michael says Chasity's angry outbursts and lack of trust has put a damper on their relationship. He says he's sick and tired of Chasity destroying their property and if she doesn't get help for her anger, he's out the door. Chasity says Michael is a liar and manipulator who tries to convince her that he's not cheating. Does Judge Faith have the right words of advice to help rekindle this hurting relationship?

programme.title: "Katie" Hagewood vs. Shawn Hagewood
programme.desc: Katie says she's done with Shawn being a mama's boy and needs him to move on from his plan of living in a bus! She says if Shawn doesn't set boundaries with his meddling mother, their marriage is over. Shawn says Katie is jealous of the relationship he has with his mother and wants her to just accept it. Can Judge Faith Jenkins drop some truth on this troubled marriage and help them avoid outside distractions?

programme.title: Lace Larrabee vs. Jarrod Harris
programme.desc: Lace says she's done with her husband's impulsive spending, constant complaining, and putting having kids on hold. Lace wants Jarrod to stop spending exuberant amounts of money without consulting her and understand how important it is for her to have a baby. Jarrod says Lace needs to stop getting so aggravated at the way he spends and start accepting that he's the man of the house. Can Judge Faith bridge the gap between these two or is the rift already too far wide?

programme.title: Carla Talley vs. Habib Talley
programme.desc: Carla says women frequently call in the middle of the night for husband Habib, saying he has traveled to stay with them for months at a time.

programme.title: "Mychael Jay" Arce vs. "Danny C" Carbone
programme.desc: "Mychael Jay" says his relationship with "Danny C" has hit rock bottom. He says "Danny C" refuses to help with rent or any other household bills, and even suspects he may be cheating on him. "Danny C" says "Mychael Jay" is nothing, but drama and he's had enough. Can Judge Faith filter through the finger pointing and accusations and get this relationship back on track?

programme.title: "Lela" Randle vs. Khalil Kearse
programme.desc: "Lela" says she's done with Khalil's gambling and anger issues and ready to call it quits. She needs him to step up to his responsibilities without giving her a fight every time. Khalil says Lela is controlling and does anything she wants without consulting him first. Though, Khalil says he's here to save his relationship and get "Lela" back. Can Judge Faith serve this couple with a cold dose of reality and wake them up before their relationship is lost?

programme.title: Jasmin Gardner vs. Travis Coleman
programme.desc: Jasmin says she wants to settle down and have kids but can't do that if Travis refuses to get his act together; he refutes that it's her cheating that has caused a major strain on relationship.

programme.title: Lasandra Raheem vs. "Raheem The Dream" (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lasandra says husband Raheem "The Dream," an Atlanta hip-hop legend, is destroying their marriage with his gambling and drinking, and bankrupting their record label; he says she is too controlling over his money, his record and his personal business.

programme.title: Lasandra Raheem vs. "Raheem The Dream" (Part 2)
programme.desc: Lasandra says husband Raheem "The Dream," an Atlanta hip-hop legend, is destroying their marriage with his gambling and drinking, and bankrupting their record label; he says she is too controlling over his money, his record and his personal business.

programme.title: Kristi Taylor vs. Ben Taylor
programme.desc: Kristi says multiple women have called the house looking for Ben at all hours of the night, and he stole her cherished cat, Mr. Pickles, in an act of revenge; he says she is a narcissistic drama queen who wants to destroy his livelihood.

programme.title: Erin Williams vs. Susan Johnson
programme.desc: Erin says she and her partner, Susan, have trust issues, communication issues, intimacy issues and an 11-year age difference that are tearing them apart; she is fed up with Susan's reckless behavior, while Susan says Erin treats her like a child.

programme.title: Macresha Preston vs. Sparkles Bolton
programme.desc: Macresha says she caught Sparkles talking to other people, only to turn around and accuse Macresha of being unfaithful; Sparkles says she has proof Macresha is having a long-distance relationship with a man.

programme.title: Mardrea Johnson vs. Laporcha Johnson
programme.desc: Mardrea says Laporcha has anger issues and shows no compassion toward her desire to have trans-male surgery; Laporcha says if Mardrea goes through with it, their marriage is over.

programme.title: Ryan Rivette vs. Amber Rivette
programme.desc: Ryan says he's had enough of Amber's headstrong attitude and reckless behavior; she says he lacks communication skills and causes arguments.

programme.title: Eddie Esparza vs. "Shari" Maull
programme.desc: Eddie says wife Shari refuses to give him sex, time or attention; she says his lack of communication, accountability and trust have caused major problems in their marriage.

programme.title: Raquel Brown vs. Julius Brown (Part 1)
programme.desc: Raquel says Julius is more like a roommate than a husband; he blames her for their falling out and says she cares more about her well-being than being a good wife.

programme.title: Raquel Brown vs. Julius Brown (Part 2)
programme.desc: Raquel says Julius is more like a roommate than a husband; he blames her for their falling out and says she cares more about her well-being than being a good wife.

programme.title: Natashia Washington vs. Phillip Washington
programme.desc: Natashia says her husband runs their house like a military base, installing cameras to watch her; Phillip says that, as a former Marine, it's his duty to run a tight ship in his home.

programme.title: Sarah Josenhans vs. Kenneth Lyas
programme.desc: Sarah says she's stuck in a relationship with a verbally abusive and financially controlling partner; Kenneth says she always runs away when he starts addressing their issues.

programme.title: Samantha Magarian vs. Darren Sullentrup
programme.desc: Samantha wants to end her five-year relationship with Darren, saying she's tired of his cheating ways; he says he gave up his dreams to support her, and she refuses to reciprocate any affection.

programme.title: Yvette Maddux vs. "Tony" Maddux
programme.desc: Yvette says her 30-year relationship with husband Anthony is hanging by a thread; she's sick of his angry fits and lack of affection; he refutes that she's the one who neglects him.

programme.title: Asha McDowell vs. Jermaine McDowell
programme.desc: Asha wants to divorce her cheating husband of 15 years unless he buys her a first-class ticket to Brazil; Jermaine says she is living in a fantasy world fueled by social media.

programme.title: Crystal Mindus vs. Amanda Bergman
programme.desc: Crystal says Amanda is an alcoholic freeloader who can't keep a job; Amanda says she has physical limitations and blames Crystal for her drinking, as she's the one buying her booze.

programme.title: Alma Rivera vs. Ronnie Mariani
programme.desc: Alma says she has no doubt that her husband, Ronnie, has been cheating on her with various women, including her close friends; he denies cheating and demands that she stop accusing him.

programme.title: Katurah Davis vs. Mikael Thomas
programme.desc: Katurah has reached her limit after five long years of putting up with Mikael's cheating and poor parenting; he says he does his best to make her happy, but it's never enough.

programme.title: Laura Carpenter vs. "Trace" Carpenter III
programme.desc: A woman says her husband has a substance abuse issue, and it's going to kill him; he claims to have put together a path to sobriety that works for him and needs her to accept it.

programme.title: Yogi Harris vs. "Ty" Gidron
programme.desc: Yolanda is over her husband's stalking and weight gain; Tyree says he just wants to be with her, and, as far as his weight is concerned, he's on a special diet of 4,000 calories a day.

programme.title: Wanda Jackson vs. "Tony" Jackson
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Wanda says her sex life with her husband, Tony, has not been the same since she had her leg amputated. She says her husband has not been supportive and to make matters worse, her meddling live-in mother-in-law is always in his ear. Tony says his wife is using her disability as an excuse to be a victim and asserts his mother is not going anywhere. Can Judge Star Jones rekindle this dying flame? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Mimi Cruz vs. Keion Green
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Mimi says she's had enough of her much younger boyfriend, Keion, being a liar and a cheater. She wants to settle down and have children and she is tired of putting her life on hold for him. Keion says Mimi is insecure and overbearing and he's tired of her treating him like a child. Can Judge Star Jones get these two to see eye to eye? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Samantha Davis vs. Matthew Davis
